questions.stem: At Cloud Kicks, when a rep needs to seek additional support help, there's a series of actions the company wants to ensure are taken. The steps include sending an email and changing the status and owner of the case. What should a Platform Administrator use to give the reps an easy way to make these updates?

options.text: Case Assignment Rules
Macros with Quick Actions
Quick Text with Email Templates
Autolaunched Flows with Email Alerts

questions.explanationEs: Una macro ejecuta con un clic una serie de pasos sobre el caso abierto en la consola: cambiar el estado y el propietario y enviar un email con plantilla, apoyándose en quick actions. Las case assignment rules y los autolaunched flows actúan solos al guardar, sin que el agente decida cuándo, y Quick Text solo inserta texto.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to initiate expense reports from Salesforce to the external HR system. Managers and directors need to review this process. Which two tools should a Platform Administrator configure?

options.text: Outbound Message
Email Alert Action
Quick Action
Approval Process

questions.explanationEs: Un approval process gestiona la revisión de managers y directores, y como acción final de aprobación puede lanzar un outbound message, que envía los datos del registro al sistema externo de RR. HH. Un email alert solo avisa por correo y una quick action no integra con otros sistemas.

questions.stem: Universal Containers' Platform Administrator has been asked to create a many-to-many relationship between two existing custom objects. Which two steps should the administrator take when enabling the many-to-many relationship?

options.text: Create a junction with a custom object.
Create two master-detail relationships on the new object.
Create URL fields on a custom object.
Create two lookup relationships on the new object.

questions.explanationEs: Una relación muchos a muchos se modela con un junction object: un objeto personalizado con dos relaciones master-detail, una hacia cada objeto. Con lookups se pierde el comportamiento de junction (propiedad y borrado heredados, roll-ups en ambos padres), y los campos URL no relacionan registros.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator is building an agent to nurture leads. How does Agentforce SDR help?

options.text: Generate a dynamic call script and talking points for the human sales reps to use.
Autonomously negotiate pricing with the lead and close the final deal.
Analyze the performance of human sales reps and provide coaching tips.
Answer the lead's questions with responses that are grounded in company data.

questions.explanationEs: Agentforce SDR trabaja leads de forma autónoma: responde sus preguntas con información fiable de la empresa (grounding en los datos de Salesforce), los cualifica y puede agendar reuniones. No negocia precios ni cierra acuerdos, ni es una herramienta de coaching para comerciales.

questions.stem: A group of sales reps can view each other's orders on a report; however, they would like a report to view just their own orders. What should a Platform Administrator do to set up a report for the sales reps?

options.text: Set the Opportunity Filter for Primary as True.
Filter by Opportunity Owner equals $USER.
Set Organization Wide Defaults of Order object to Private.
Save the report in a private folder for the user.

questions.explanationEs: Filtrar el informe por propietario igual a $USER, el usuario que lo ejecuta, hace que cada comercial vea solo sus registros con el mismo informe; en Lightning se suele hacer con el filtro «Show Me: My…». Cambiar el OWD a Private quitaría visibilidad que sí necesitan, y una carpeta privada no filtra datos.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks is working on a rebrand. In which two areas of the Salesforce mobile app can a Platform Administrator customize the branding?

options.text: App header color
Record background color
Loading page logo
Header background color

questions.explanationEs: En la configuración de marca de la app móvil se puede subir el logo de la pantalla de carga y elegir el color de marca, que se aplica al fondo de la cabecera. El fondo de los registros no se personaliza.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty has an approval process. A manager attempts to approve a record but receives an error. What should a Platform Administrator do to troubleshoot this issue?

options.text: Check if the user in the next approver is inactive or missing.
Review the page layout to ensure the fields updated in the process are visible.
Update the field-level security to view on fields that are updated in the process.
Add a delegated approver for the next approver in the process.

questions.explanationEs: Si un manager intenta aprobar y salta un error, una causa típica es que el siguiente aprobador del proceso esté inactivo o vacío, porque la solicitud no se puede enrutar. La visibilidad de campos o la FLS no hacen fallar la aprobación, y añadir un delegated approver no arregla un paso mal definido.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) customers have provided feedback that their support cases are not being responded to quickly enough. UC wants to send all unassigned cases that have been open for more than 2 hours to an urgent Case queue and alert the support manager. Which feature should a Platform Administrator configure to meet this requirement?

options.text: Case Scheduled Reports
Case Dashboard Refreshes
Case Escalation Rules
Case Assignment Rules

questions.explanationEs: Las case escalation rules actúan cuando un caso lleva cierto tiempo sin resolver: lo reasignan a otra cola (la urgente) y notifican a quien indiques, aquí el manager de soporte. Las assignment rules solo se aplican al crear o editar el caso, y los informes o dashboards no mueven casos.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has an administrator team that manages the org. The company has asked for a small subset of leadership users to have Modify All access, like the administrators have. How should the administrator team accomplish this?

options.text: Assign the standard Platform User profile to the leadership users and edit the permissions to Modify All access.
Assign the standard System Administrator profile to the leadership users that includes the Modify All access.
Assign the standard User profile to the leadership users and add a custom permission set with Modify All access.
Clone the standard User profile to the leadership users and assign a Modify All role to grant access.

questions.explanationEs: Por mínimo privilegio, se mantiene el perfil habitual de esos usuarios y se añade un permission set con el permiso necesario (Modify All en los objetos que toque, o Modify All Data). El perfil System Administrator les daría control de toda la configuración, los perfiles estándar no se pueden editar y los roles no conceden permisos.

questions.stem: At Cloud Kicks, cases are being assigned a default Case Owner and showing a Created By and Last Modified By that is not expected. The company wants to change this to an integration user to alleviate confusion with the business. What should a Platform Administrator edit to change this in Salesforce?

options.text: Process Automation Settings
Debug Logs
Support Processes
Support Settings

questions.explanationEs: En Support Settings se definen el Default Case Owner y el Automated Case User, que aparece como autor de los cambios hechos por automatismos (assignment rules, escalation rules, Email-to-Case…). Poner ahí un usuario de integración evita que los casos parezcan creados o modificados por una persona.

questions.stem: A sales rep wants to be able to categorize multiple picklist values into a single value on a report. Which option should a Platform Administrator suggest to the sales rep to accomplish this?

options.text: Bucket Column
Unique Count
Report Filter
Chart

questions.explanationEs: Un bucket column agrupa en el propio informe varios valores de un campo en categorías nuevas, por ejemplo varios sectores en «Servicios financieros», sin crear campos ni tocar datos. Un filtro excluiría registros, el unique count cuenta valores distintos y un gráfico solo visualiza.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has two sales teams, sales team A and sales team B. Each team has their own role in the role hierarchy. Both roles are subordinates of the same Manager role. How should a Platform Administrator share records owned by sales team A with sales team B?

options.text: Criteria-based sharing
Owner-based sharing
Hierarchical sharing
Manual sharing

questions.explanationEs: Con un modelo privado, dos roles hermanos no se ven entre sí, porque la jerarquía solo da acceso hacia arriba. Una sharing rule de propietario que comparta los registros del rol Sales Team A con el rol Sales Team B resuelve el acceso lateral. Compartir a mano no escala, y las reglas por criterios son para cuando el acceso depende de valores de campos.

questions.stem: The client services and customer support teams share the same profile but have different permission sets. The custom object Retention related list needs to be restricted to the client services team on the Lightning record page layout. What should a Platform Administrator use to fulfill this request?

options.text: Page Layout Assignment
Component Visibility
Record Type Assignment
Sharing Settings

questions.explanationEs: Como comparten perfil, la diferencia está en los permisos: en Lightning App Builder se añade un filtro de visibilidad al componente de la related list, por ejemplo con un custom permission incluido solo en el permission set de Client Services. Las asignaciones de page layout y de record type van por perfil, y las sharing settings controlan datos, no la interfaz.

questions.stem: Users at Cloud Kicks want to see information that is more useful for their role on the Case page. How should a Platform Administrator make the pages more dynamic and easier to use?

options.text: Add component visibility filters to the components.
Include more tab components with filters.
Remove fields from the record details component.
Delete the extra components from the page.

questions.explanationEs: Los filtros de visibilidad de Lightning App Builder muestran u ocultan componentes según el usuario (perfil, permisos), el dispositivo o valores del registro, así que cada rol ve lo útil en la misma página. Borrar componentes o campos afectaría a todos por igual.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks has set up a junior administrator as a delegated administrator in Salesforce. What should the Platform Administrator consider regarding delegated administrators?

options.text: Delegated administrators can unlock users but cannot reset passwords.
Delegated administrators can update field-level security on standard objects.
Delegated administrators cannot modify permission sets.
Delegated administrators cannot assign users to profiles.

questions.explanationEs: Los delegated administrators gestionan usuarios de los roles que se les asignan: crean y editan usuarios, restablecen contraseñas, desbloquean cuentas y asignan los perfiles y permission sets permitidos. Lo que no pueden es crear ni modificar permission sets, ni cambiar la field-level security.

questions.stem: Which two data loss considerations should a Platform Administrator keep in mind when changing a custom field type from Text to Picklist?

options.text: Auto updates will be made to Visualforce references to prevent data loss.
Any list view based on the custom field is deleted.
There will be no data loss with use of a global value set.
Assignment and escalation rules may be affected.

questions.explanationEs: Pasar un campo de texto a picklist puede perder datos, y según la documentación se borran las list views que usan ese campo y pueden verse afectadas las assignment y escalation rules que lo referencian. Salesforce no actualiza solo las referencias en Visualforce, y un global value set no evita la pérdida de datos.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has been seeing exponential growth and will be hiring an additional 10 sales reps and 15 support reps to its teams. The support team will need access to the Service Console to manage cases. A Platform Administrator will be assigning the users to existing custom sales and support profiles. How should the administrator ensure the support reps have the appropriate access to the console?

options.text: Enable the Service Cloud User feature license for the support reps on the User Detail page.
Create a permission set for the Service Console and assign it to the support reps.
Build a Service Console using Lightning App Builder for the custom service profile.
Assign the Salesforce Platform User License to the support reps.

questions.explanationEs: La Service Console exige la feature license Service Cloud User, que se activa con la casilla del mismo nombre en el registro de cada usuario. Un permission set no concede feature licenses, y la licencia Salesforce Platform no incluye casos ni la consola.

questions.stem: What is an Agentforce use case in a sales organization?

options.text: Generating cold calls
Automating all marketing content
Providing basic web bot chats
Automating Lead Qualification

questions.explanationEs: Un caso de uso típico de Agentforce en ventas es cualificar leads: el agente conversa con el prospecto, hace preguntas de descubrimiento, decide si cumple los criterios y actualiza el registro o agenda una reunión. Los bots básicos siguen guiones fijos, y «automatizar todo el marketing» no es un caso de uso concreto.

questions.stem: The Cloud Kicks CFO requires any opportunity over $100,000 to be automatically sent to them, so they can sign off on the record before the deal closes. Which feature should a Platform Administrator use to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Submit for Approval button
Einstein Next Best Action
Apex Triggers
Flow Approvals

questions.explanationEs: Para que las oportunidades de más de 100 000 $ lleguen solas al CFO, un record-triggered flow con esa condición las envía a aprobación (Flow Approvals), sin que el comercial pulse nada. El botón Submit for Approval es manual, Next Best Action solo recomienda y un Apex trigger es código innecesario.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks uses the standard Account Type field to indicate different account tiers. Users find this confusing, so management has asked that the field be changed to read "Tier" on the page layouts. How should a Platform Administrator implement this change?

options.text: Edit the Type field and change the name.
Use Rename Tabs and Labels.
Build a custom field called Tier and delete Type.
Create a global picklist value set.

questions.explanationEs: Las etiquetas de campos estándar como Type se cambian con Rename Tabs and Labels, y el cambio se ve en layouts, informes y list views sin tocar los datos. Crear un campo nuevo y borrar el estándar sería destructivo, y un global value set no cambia etiquetas.

questions.stem: In an approval process, which feature allows a user to temporarily assign their approval responsibilities to another user for a predefined time period?

options.text: Approval Rule
Queue
Delegated Approver
Manager

questions.explanationEs: Un delegated approver puede aprobar o rechazar las solicitudes en nombre de otro usuario, por ejemplo durante sus vacaciones; se indica en el registro del usuario. Una queue reparte aprobaciones entre varias personas, y el manager es parte fija de la jerarquía.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator needs to configure an approval process for the sales team when opportunities that meet particular conditions are closed. How should the administrator make sure the right records are included in the process?

options.text: Add Specific Entry Criteria.
Use Dynamic Forms to display a button.
Create a screen flow.
Add a validation rule to the opportunity.

questions.explanationEs: Los entry criteria del approval process deciden qué registros pueden entrar, por ejemplo Stage = Closed Won y un importe mínimo; si un registro no los cumple, no se puede enviar a aprobación. Ni un screen flow ni una validation rule sustituyen ese filtro.

questions.stem: At Cloud Kicks, sales reps use discounts on the opportunity record to help win sales on particular products. When an opportunity is won, they then have to manually apply the discount to the related opportunity products. The sales manager has asked if there is a way to automate this time-consuming task. What should a Platform Administrator use to deliver this requirement?

options.text: Approval Process
Formula Field
Flow Builder
Prebuilt Macro

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow sobre Opportunity que se dispare al pasar a Closed Won puede obtener los Opportunity Products y aplicarles el descuento en bloque. Un formula field solo calcula para mostrar y no escribe en otros registros, y ni una macro ni un approval process actualizan registros hijos.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to roll out the Salesforce mobile app, and the first information it wants its users to see is the Top Opportunities report. What should a Platform Administrator configure to achieve this?

options.text: Add the Reports tab to the Salesforce mobile app.
Enable Today for the Salesforce mobile app.
Enable Mobile Home for the Salesforce mobile app.
Add the Dashboards tab to the Salesforce mobile app.

questions.explanationEs: Mobile Home es la página de inicio configurable de la app móvil: decide qué ve el usuario nada más abrirla, así que es donde se coloca la información clave. Añadir las pestañas de informes o de dashboards no hace que sea lo primero que se ve, y Today se centra en la agenda del día.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks would like to use Salesforce to start tracking details around its marketing efforts. They would like to track details around emails, trade shows, and webinars. Additionally, each of these initiatives will need to track different types of information. How should the administrator accomplish this?

options.text: Create a custom report type with relevant fields.
Create a custom field on the Campaign object for the type of initiative.
Create record types and page layouts for each type of campaign.
Use campaign hierarchies to organize campaign types.

questions.explanationEs: Cuando un mismo objeto debe recoger información distinta según el tipo de iniciativa, se usan record types con su propio page layout y sus valores de picklist: Email, Trade Show y Webinar ven cada uno sus campos. Un campo de tipo no oculta los campos que no aplican, y la jerarquía de campañas sirve para agrupar campañas.

questions.stem: Sales reps miss key fields when filling out an opportunity record through the sales process. Reps need to move forward in stages but are unable to enter a previous stage. Which three options should a Platform Administrator use to address this need?

options.text: Mark fields required on the page layout.
Use Flow to mark fields required.
Configure Opportunity Path.
Use validation rules.
Enable guided selling.

questions.explanationEs: Path muestra la etapa actual con sus key fields y consejos; las validation rules impiden avanzar sin rellenar lo necesario; y los campos obligatorios en el page layout aseguran lo básico. Flow no es la forma de marcar campos obligatorios, y «guided selling» no es una función estándar de oportunidades.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator wants to limit the kinds of reports their users can create. Which tool should the administrator use?

options.text: Hide Report Types
Report Folder Sharing
Standard Report Types
Joined Report

questions.explanationEs: En Reports and Dashboards Settings puedes ocultar report types para que no aparezcan al crear informes, lo que limita qué tipos de informe se pueden hacer. Compartir carpetas controla quién ve los informes ya creados, no cuáles se pueden crear.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator for Cloud Kicks needs to ensure that only the financial records belonging to each individual user are visible on the report in order to meet scope of the data privacy requirements. How should the administrator achieve this?

options.text: Set sharing model as Public Read/Write for the respective object(s).
Set sharing model as Private for the respective object(s).
Create multiple reports, each filtered to show records owned by each user.
Use Apex sharing to hide records.

questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD del objeto en Private, cada usuario solo ve sus registros (y los de quien tenga por debajo en la jerarquía), y los informes siempre respetan esa visibilidad. Hacer un informe por usuario no protege nada, y Apex sharing es innecesario.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Ursa Major Solar imported records into an object by mistake. Which two tools should the administrator use to undo this import?

options.text: Weekly Data Export
Data Loader
Data Import Wizard
Mass Delete Records

questions.explanationEs: Deshacer una importación es borrar lo que se creó: Mass Delete Records lo hace desde Setup para objetos estándar comunes, y Data Loader puede borrar en bloque con el fichero de éxito de la importación, que trae los Id. El Data Import Wizard no borra, y la Weekly Data Export es una copia de seguridad.

questions.stem: There are multiple system administrators at Cloud Kicks that make configuration changes. Which tool gives the system administrators the ability to track these changes?

options.text: Health Check
Setup Audit Trail
History Tracking
Feed Tracking

questions.explanationEs: Setup Audit Trail registra los cambios de configuración (quién hizo qué y cuándo) de los últimos 180 días. Field history tracking y feed tracking siguen cambios en los datos de los registros, y Health Check compara tu seguridad con una línea base.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator has been asked to change the data type of an auto number to a text field. What should the administrator be aware of before changing the field?

options.text: Existing field values will remain unchanged.
Changing Auto Number field to Text is prevented.
Existing field values will be deleted.
Existing field values will be converted.

questions.explanationEs: Al pasar un campo de Auto Number a Text, los valores existentes se conservan tal cual como texto; lo único que cambia es que los registros nuevos ya no se numeran solos.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar has its business hours set from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM for the reps that are on Pacific Time. The reps on Eastern Time need business hours set to start 3 hours earlier to cover for support. How should a Platform Administrator solve for this issue?

options.text: Adjust the current business hours to accommodate the Eastern time zone.
Allow the reps to set business hours manually.
Set temporary business hours for each time zone.
Create one set of business hours per time zone.

questions.explanationEs: Cada zona horaria necesita su propio registro de Business Hours, que se asigna a los casos o reglas que correspondan, porque escalation rules y milestones cuentan el tiempo según ese horario. Ampliar el horario actual para cubrir a los dos equipos falsearía los cálculos.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to assist users with a guided expense report process to simplify submissions, routing, and authorizations. Which two tools should a Platform Administrator use to build this solution?

options.text: Validation Rule
Quick Action
Flow Builder
Approval Process

questions.explanationEs: Un screen flow guía al usuario paso a paso para enviar el gasto y, al terminar, lo manda a un approval process, que se encarga del enrutado y de las autorizaciones. Una quick action solo sería la forma de lanzar el flow, y una validation rule ni guía ni enruta.

questions.stem: A sales rep has a list of 300 accounts with contacts that they want to load at one time. Which tool should a Platform Administrator utilize to import the records to Salesforce?

options.text: Dataloader.io
Manual Import
Data Import Wizard
Data Loader

questions.explanationEs: Para 300 cuentas con sus contactos, el Data Import Wizard es lo más sencillo: funciona en el navegador, importa cuentas y contactos a la vez relacionándolos y comprueba duplicados. Data Loader y dataloader.io también sirven, pero están pensados para volúmenes mayores u objetos que el wizard no admite.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator has reviewed an upcoming critical update. How should the administrator proceed with activation of the critical update?

options.text: Allow the critical update to auto-activate in a sandbox.
Activate the critical update in production.
Activate the critical update in a sandbox.
Allow the critical update to auto-activate.

questions.explanationEs: La buena práctica es activar y probar la actualización en un sandbox, corregir lo que se rompa y luego activarla en producción antes de su fecha de activación automática. Dejar que se active sola, o activarla directamente en producción, es arriesgarse a romper algo.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator is building an agent to help an ecommerce support team. The agent needs to call an action, named updateShippingAddress, that modifies a customer's shipping address in the system. Which set of Action Instructions should the administrator use for the updateShippingAddress action, according to best practices?

options.text: "Use this to update shipping information. It's used for any changes to a customer's address in the system."
"This action updates the customer's shipping address. It is to be used when a user wants to change their address. Only use this when a customer does not have an active order in the system."
"This action allows for the changing of a shipping address, and the goal is to make sure the address is current and accurate."

"Updates the shipping address for a customer order. The goal of the action is to modify the address on a customer's record. The agent should only use this action when the user explicitly requests to change their address."

questions.explanationEs: Las instrucciones de una acción deben decir qué hace, para qué sirve y cuándo usarla. La mejor deja claro que modifica la dirección del registro y que el agente solo debe usarla cuando el usuario pide expresamente cambiarla. Las otras son vagas o añaden una condición (que no haya pedidos activos) que no forma parte del requisito.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to automatically notify a manager about any cases awaiting a response from an agent for more than 2 hours after case creation. Which feature should a Platform Administrator use to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Assignment Rule
Case Escalation Rule
Formula field
Omni-Channel Supervisor

questions.explanationEs: Una case escalation rule con una entrada de 2 horas desde la creación y un criterio como Status = New avisa al manager cuando se cumple el plazo. Las assignment rules actúan al crear el caso, un formula field no envía avisos, y Omni-Channel Supervisor es para supervisar en tiempo real.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Ursa Major Solar wants to add prepopulated subjects for Tasks and Events. Tasks should have the subjects "Schedule Site Visit" and "Send Contract", while Events should have the subjects "Site Visit" and "Ride Along". What should the administrator configure to achieve this requirement?

options.text: Add the new values to the predefined field values for the global actions New Event and New Task.
Add Schedule Site Visit and Send Contract picklist values for the Task subject field. Add Site Visit and Ride Along picklist values for the Event subject field.
Create a new custom Subject picklist field on Activity and add the field values.
Include Schedule Site Visit, Send Contract, Site Visit, and Ride Along picklist values for the Activity subject field.

questions.explanationEs: Task y Event tienen cada uno su propio campo Subject con su lista de valores, así que los de tareas se añaden al Subject de Task y los de eventos al de Event. Juntarlos todos mezclaría ambos, y los predefined field values de una acción fijan un valor por defecto, no la lista.

questions.stem: How should a Platform Administrator view Currencies, Fiscal Year settings, and Business Hours in Salesforce?

options.text: User Management Settings
Company Settings
Custom Settings
Feature Settings

questions.explanationEs: En Company Settings están la información de la empresa (zona horaria, divisa corporativa, licencias), Fiscal Year, Business Hours, Holidays y, con multidivisa, la gestión de divisas. User Management Settings, Custom Settings y Feature Settings son otra cosa.

questions.stem: A user at Northern Trail Outfitters is having trouble logging in to Salesforce. The user's login history shows that this person has attempted to log in multiple times and has been locked out of the organization. Which two steps should a Platform Administrator take to help the user log in to Salesforce?

options.text: Log in as the user to unlock the user and reset the password.
Use the unlock button on the user's record detail page.
Reset password on the user's record detail page.
Reset the password policies to allow the user to login.

questions.explanationEs: A un usuario bloqueado por intentos fallidos se le desbloquea con el botón Unlock de su registro, y si no recuerda la contraseña se le envía un enlace con Reset Password. Iniciar sesión como él no lo desbloquea, y cambiar las políticas de contraseñas afecta a toda la org.

questions.stem: Sales managers would like to know what could be implemented to surface important values based on the stage of the opportunity? Which tool should a Platform Administrator use to meet this requirement?

options.text: Workflow Rules
Path Key Fields
Opportunity Processes
Dynamic Forms

questions.explanationEs: En Path puedes definir para cada etapa unos key fields, que se muestran y editan justo en ese momento del proceso, junto con la Guidance for Success. Dynamic Forms muestra campos según criterios, pero no está ligado a las etapas como Path.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator needs to enable Agentforce for the service team. What is the most critical prerequisite for ensuring the Service Agents have a complete and accurate view of their customers?

options.text: Activate Email-to-Case for the agent.
Configure a new Service Console layout.
Verify Data Cloud is implemented.
Create new user profiles for the agent.

questions.explanationEs: Para que los agentes tengan una vista completa y fiable del cliente, sus datos deben estar unificados: Data Cloud ingiere y armoniza datos de distintas fuentes y es la base en la que Agentforce se apoya (grounding). Email-to-Case o un nuevo layout de consola no aportan esa vista unificada.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator created a new prompt template and is testing it. Every time the administrator tests the template, it gives a different response. Why is the prompt template giving different responses each time it' s run?

options.text: Prompt Builder caches the large language model's response, so the prompt is only sent once for every template the administrator creates.
Every time the administrator runs a prompt template in Prompt Builder, it creates a unique call to the large language model.
The prompt is only sent to the large language model after the administrator deploys the template to a live agent, not when the prompt is run in the builder.
Prompt Builder runs a simulated call to the large language model to save on costs, so the prompt is never sent to the actual model.

questions.explanationEs: Cada prueba de una plantilla en Prompt Builder es una llamada nueva al LLM, y los modelos generativos no son deterministas: la respuesta varía. Para resultados más consistentes hay que afinar las instrucciones; no hay caché ni simulación.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks has a flow in production that is supposed to create new records. However, no new records are being created. What is causing the issue?

options.text: The flow is inactive.
The flow URL is deactivated.
The flow is Read Only.
The flow trigger is missing.

questions.explanationEs: Un flow solo se ejecuta si su versión está activa; si no crea registros en producción, lo primero es comprobar que se activó. Un record-triggered flow no se puede guardar sin desencadenante, y ni ser de solo lectura ni la URL impiden que se ejecute.

questions.stem: Universal Containers (UC) has a private sharing model for Opportunities and uses Opportunity teams. Criteria- based sharing rules are not used. A sales rep at UC leaves the company, and their user record is deactivated. The rep is later rehired in the same role. A Platform Administrator activates the old user record. The user is added to the same default Opportunity teams but is no longer able to see the same records the user worked on before leaving the company. What is the likely cause?

options.text: The stage of the opportunity records was changed to Closed Lost.
The record type of the opportunity records was changed.
The records were manually shared with the user.
Permission sets were removed when the user was deactivated.

questions.explanationEs: Al desactivar un usuario se eliminan los registros que le habían compartido manualmente, y reactivarlo no los recupera. Como la org no usa sharing rules por criterios, lo más probable es que ese acceso viniera de compartición manual.

questions.stem: Which task is especially suited for Agentforce?

options.text: Single-step predefined processes
Static document generation
Multi-step processes that need adaption to change
Tasks without decision-making

questions.explanationEs: Agentforce brilla en procesos de varios pasos que requieren razonar y adaptarse: entiende la intención, elige qué acciones ejecutar y cambia de plan si la conversación cambia. Para tareas de un solo paso o sin decisiones, un flow o una macro son más sencillos y baratos.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters has two different sales processes: one for business opportunities with four stages and one for partner opportunities with eight stages. Both processes will vary in page layouts and picklist value options. What should a Platform Administrator configure to meet these requirements?

options.text: Different page layouts that control the picklist values for the opportunity types
Separate record types and sales processes for the different types of opportunities
Validation rules that ensure that users are entering accurate sales stage information
Public groups to limit record types and sales processes for opportunities

questions.explanationEs: Un sales process define qué valores de Stage se ven, así que se crean dos (uno de 4 etapas y otro de 8) y se asocia cada uno a un record type con su propio page layout. Los page layouts no controlan valores de picklist, y los public groups no asignan record types.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator assigned a custom profile based on the Minimum Access named Salesforce profile to a group of new users and assigned them several existing permission sets. However, when the users log in, they do not see the Lightning interface. Which action should the administrator take to give the users access to the Lightning interface?

options.text: Enable the Enhanced Interface for User Access Policies.
Add Lightning component to a layout.
Create a page in Lightning App Builder with the org as default.
Assign a permission to enable Lightning Experience User.

questions.explanationEs: El perfil Minimum Access – Salesforce no incluye el permiso Lightning Experience User, así que hay que darlo, mejor con un permission set, para que puedan entrar en Lightning. Crear páginas o componentes no sirve si no tienen acceso a Lightning.

questions.stem: The Activity Timeline is missing from the Account record page. What should a Platform Administrator do to correct this?

options.text: Add the standard Activities component to the Account Lightning record page.
Update the user's permission to allow Edit access to the Activity Timeline.
Run a report to verify whether any activities have been logged for that Account.
Add a button for the Activity Timeline in the Object Manager for the Account object.

questions.explanationEs: La Activity Timeline es un componente de la página de registro: si falta, se añade el componente Activities a la Lightning record page de Account con Lightning App Builder. No es un permiso ni un botón del Object Manager.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to implement collaborative selling where multiple roles work together on customer accounts. Sales reps need full access to their assigned accounts, while customer support reps and sales engineers need access to opportunities and cases related to specific accounts they support. The sales manager wants to streamline the process by automatically adding the same team members to multiple accounts. Which feature should a Platform Administrator configure to meet this requirement?

options.text: Set up default account teams with specified access levels for different team roles.
Create sharing rules to grant access to opportunities and cases for support teams.
Configure role hierarchy to automatically grant account access to the appropriate teams.
Use permission sets to provide additional access to account-related records.

questions.explanationEs: Los account teams permiten que varias personas trabajen una cuenta, cada una con su rol y su nivel de acceso a la cuenta, sus oportunidades y sus casos. Con un default account team, el propietario añade a su equipo habitual de una vez a cada cuenta. Las sharing rules o la jerarquía no van cuenta por cuenta.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar (UMS) wants a place within Salesforce to discuss sensitive records. UMS would like to be able to add new members but does not want non-members to be able to see any information about the forum. What should a Platform Administrator configure to achieve this?

options.text: Chatter Unlisted Group
Chatter Private Group
Chatter Public Group
Private Chatter Channel

questions.explanationEs: Un grupo unlisted de Chatter no aparece en búsquedas ni listados: solo lo conocen sus miembros (y quien tenga permiso para gestionar grupos unlisted), y se entra por invitación. Un grupo privado sí aparece en búsquedas aunque su contenido esté oculto.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar's Platform Administrator is editing the page layout for a new custom object. A text area field is accidentally removed from the page layout, and it needs to be restored to the page layout. What are two methods for achieving this goal?

options.text: Clone the layout from a different profile and use save as.
Restore original page layout from a sandbox.
Restore from the recycle bin within 15 days.
From the fields palette, drag the field into the same position.

questions.explanationEs: Quitar un campo del layout no lo borra, así que se puede volver a arrastrar desde la paleta de campos del Page Layout Editor. Si el layout ha cambiado mucho, también puedes volver a desplegar la versión original desde un sandbox. La papelera es para registros y campos borrados, no para layouts.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to see collaboration and updates across various Chatter groups, records, and announcements from the CEO in a single place. What should a Platform Administrator configure to achieve this?

options.text: Chatter Group
Chatter Daily Digest
Chatter Feed
Chatter Stream

questions.explanationEs: Un Chatter stream combina en un solo feed las publicaciones de las personas, grupos y registros que elijas, por ejemplo el CEO, varios grupos y ciertos registros. Un grupo es un espacio concreto, y el daily digest es un resumen por email.

questions.stem: Users at DreamHouse Realty are only allowed to see opportunities they own. Leadership wants an enterprise- wide dashboard of all open opportunities in the pipeline so that users can see how the company is performing at any point in time. How should a Platform Administrator create the dashboard without changing any sharing settings?

options.text: Create a dashboard with the running user set as someone who can see all opportunities.
Add a filter to the dashboard to filter the opportunities by owner role.
Build individual dashboards for profiles that need to see the enterprise results.
Update the dashboard folder settings to manager for the sales reps role.

questions.explanationEs: Un dashboard con un running user que ve todas las oportunidades muestra los totales de toda la empresa a cualquiera que lo abra, sin tocar la compartición. Al bajar al detalle, cada uno solo ve lo que puede ver. Filtrar o cambiar la carpeta no amplía los datos.

questions.stem: Leadership at Cloud Kicks wants to go beyond knowing how long a case has been open for, to knowing how long a case has sat with different teams. Which tool gives a Platform Administrator the ability to track the time a case sits and provide relevant reporting?

options.text: Escalation Rules with Business Hours
Record-Triggered Flows with Business Hours
Case Assignment Rules with Business Hours
Milestones with Business Hours

questions.explanationEs: Los milestones de entitlement management miden el tiempo de pasos concretos del soporte (primera respuesta, resolución…) contando solo las business hours, y se pueden reportar. Las escalation rules y las assignment rules mueven casos, pero no miden ni informan de cuánto tiempo pasan en cada fase.

questions.stem: Management at Universal Containers would like to share dashboard components with their team in Chatter but currently does not have access to this capability. How should a Platform Administrator make this functionality available to management?

options.text: Enable reporting snapshots.
Select Download Chart on the component.
Set View Dashboard As to the dashboard viewer.
Enable dashboard feed tracking.

questions.explanationEs: Para publicar en Chatter instantáneas de componentes de dashboards hay que activar el feed tracking de Dashboards. Los reporting snapshots guardan históricos de datos, y descargar el gráfico es un paso manual.

questions.stem: A sales rep typically has several open opportunities for each of their accounts. Which tool should a Platform Administrator suggest to the sales rep to obtain the total number of accounts associated with open opportunities in a report?

options.text: Bucket Column
Report Filter
Unique Count
Group Rows

questions.explanationEs: Con Show Unique Count en la columna de cuenta, el informe cuenta cada cuenta una sola vez aunque tenga varias oportunidades. Agrupar filas las ordena pero no da ese total directamente, y ni un bucket ni un filtro cuentan valores distintos.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator deactivates an agent to add a new topic and action. What happens to any ongoing user conversations with the agent?

options.text: The agent will pause the conversation and resume once reactivated.
The agent will continue conversations using the deactivated agent until reactivated.
The agent window automatically closes to prevent new messages.
The agent will send a system error message as a response to any new messages.

questions.reviewNote: No he podido confirmar en la documentación qué pasa exactamente con las conversaciones en curso al desactivar un agente, y la redacción de la respuesta de la fuente es confusa. Trátala con cautela.
questions.explanationEs: Para modificar un agente activo hay que desactivarlo (o crear una versión nueva). Según la fuente, las conversaciones en curso siguen con la configuración con la que empezaron hasta que terminan, y no se pueden iniciar nuevas hasta reactivarlo.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks is concerned that not everyone on the sales team is entering key data into accounts and opportunities that they own. Also, the team is concerned that if the key information changes, it does not get updated in Salesforce. A Platform Administrator wants to get a better understanding of their data quality and record completeness. What should the administrator do to accomplish this?

options.text: Explore AppExchange for data quality and record completeness solutions.
Create a report for Accounts and Opportunities highlighting missing data.
Subscribe the sales reps to a monthly report for accounts and opportunities.
Configure the key fields as required fields on the page layout.

questions.explanationEs: Para entender la calidad y la completitud de los datos primero hay que medirlas: un informe o dashboard de cuentas y oportunidades con los campos clave vacíos muestra dónde faltan. Hacer los campos obligatorios evita el problema desde ahora, pero no enseña lo que ya falta.

questions.stem: When a qualified lead is converted, what happens to its related records?

options.text: Records from custom objects are attached to the resulting contact, account, and opportunity records.
Open activities only are attached to the resulting contact, account, and opportunity records.
All activities are attached to the resulting contact, account, and opportunity records.
Campaign history is attached to the resulting contact, account, and opportunity records.

questions.explanationEs: Al convertir un lead, todas sus actividades, abiertas y cerradas, pasan a la cuenta, el contacto y la oportunidad resultantes. Los registros de objetos personalizados relacionados no se mueven solos, y la historia de campañas pasa al contacto.

questions.stem: The call center manager at Ursa Major Solar wants to provide agents with a case dashboard that can be drilled down by case origin, status, and owner. What should a Platform Administrator add to the dashboard to fulfill the request?

options.text: Dashboard Filter
Dashboard Widget
Combination Chart
Bucket Column

questions.explanationEs: Los filtros de dashboard (hasta tres) permiten a quien lo mira filtrar todos los componentes por un valor: origen, estado o propietario del caso. Un bucket column agrupa dentro de un informe, y un gráfico combinado no filtra.

questions.stem: Which two solutions is a Platform Administrator able to find on AppExchange to enhance their organization?

options.text: Components
Customers
Communities
Consultants

questions.explanationEs: En AppExchange se encuentran apps y componentes (por ejemplo, Lightning components para tus páginas) y también un directorio de consultores para ayudarte con la implantación. Clientes o comunidades no son algo que se «encuentre» allí.

questions.stem: Senior leadership wants to be notified of any opportunities over $250,000 with more than a 75% probability of closing. Which feature should a Platform Administrator set up to facilitate this?

options.text: Guidance for Success
Big Deal Alerts
Reports and Dashboards
Similar Opportunities

questions.explanationEs: Big Deal Alert envía un email automático cuando una oportunidad supera el importe y la probabilidad que definas, aquí 250 000 $ y 75 %. Un informe o dashboard hay que ir a consultarlo, y Guidance for Success o Similar Opportunities no avisan a nadie.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants users to only be able to choose the opportunity stage Closed Won if the Lead source has been selected. How should a Platform Administrator accomplish this goal?

options.text: Make Lead source a dependent picklist to the Opportunity Stage field.
Change the Opportunity Stage field to Read Only on the page layout.
Configure a validation rule requiring Lead source when the stage is set to Closed Won.
Make the opportunity stage a dependent picklist to the Lead source.

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule que salte cuando Stage = Closed Won y Lead Source está vacío impide guardar como ganada una oportunidad sin origen. Las dependent picklists filtran valores, pero no obligan a rellenar otro campo.

questions.stem: Sales reps at Ursa Major Solar are having difficulty managing deals. The leadership team has asked a Platform Administrator to help sales reps prioritize and close more deals. What should the administrator configure to help with these issues?

options.text: Einstein Search Personalization
Einstein Lead Scoring
Einstein Opportunity Scoring
Einstein Activity Capture

questions.explanationEs: Einstein Opportunity Scoring puntúa cada oportunidad abierta según su probabilidad de ganarse y muestra los factores que suben o bajan la nota, para que los comerciales prioricen. Lead Scoring trabaja con leads, Activity Capture registra emails y eventos, y Search Personalization afecta a la búsqueda.

questions.stem: Users have reported that the new Lightning account record page is loading very slowly. Which feature should a Platform Administrator use to determine the cause of the performance issues?

options.text: Lightning Usage App
Lightning Analytics
Lightning Page Visibility Rule
Lightning App Builder Analytics

questions.explanationEs: El botón Analyze de Lightning App Builder evalúa el rendimiento de la página que estás editando y sugiere mejoras, como mover componentes a pestañas. La Lightning Usage App da métricas de uso de toda la org, no el diagnóstico de una página.

questions.stem: What is the next step an agent performs when the tasks within an agentic loop are all unsatisfactory?

options.text: Provides the best answer possible with caveats
Gives an error message
Routes to a live agent
Asks for additional information

questions.explanationEs: Si las acciones del bucle no dan un resultado satisfactorio, el agente pide al usuario más información o una aclaración y vuelve a intentarlo con mejores datos. Pasar la conversación a una persona es la escalada para cuando ni así lo resuelve o el usuario lo pide.

questions.stem: A sales manager at Cloud Kicks would like a dashboard to emphasize some important data and tell a more compelling data story to the sales reps. How should a Platform Administrator achieve this for the sales manager?

options.text: Use a Text Widget.
Assign a new Task to each rep.
Use the Highlights Panel.
Send out a mass email.

questions.explanationEs: Un text widget añade títulos, contexto y mensajes entre los componentes del dashboard, lo que ayuda a contar una historia con los datos. El Highlights Panel es de las páginas de registro, no de los dashboards.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to ensure new Contacts are validated before they can be saved. If a user selects that the LeadSource picklist value is Other, NTO also wants to populate a custom text field called Source__c. Which validation rule should a Platform Administrator configure to meet this requirement?

options.text: AND(LeadSource = 'Other', Source__c = '')
AND(NOT(LeadSource = 'Other'), NOT(Source__c = ''))
AND(ISPICKVAL(LeadSource,'Other'), ISBLANK(Source__c))
AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(LeadSource,'Other'))), NOT(ISBLANK(Source__c))

questions.explanationEs: Para comprobar un picklist en una fórmula hay que usar ISPICKVAL (no se puede comparar con =), y para saber si un texto está vacío, ISBLANK. La regla debe dar error cuando se cumplen las dos cosas a la vez: AND(ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, 'Other'), ISBLANK(Source__c)).

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to ensure that every client has support based on the level of service that has been agreed on in the sales cycle. There are tiers to this support model, Gold, Silver, and Bronze. What should a Platform Administrator create to ensure that this is part of every client's account once they become a client?

options.text: A flow to assign Entitlements
Routing Configuration for each client
Email to Case for each service level
Case Assignment Rules for each client

questions.explanationEs: Los niveles de servicio Gold, Silver y Bronze se modelan con entitlements, y un record-triggered flow puede crear o asociar el entitlement adecuado cuando la cuenta pasa a ser cliente. El routing, Email-to-Case o las assignment rules deciden quién atiende, no qué servicio corresponde.

questions.stem: Which Salesforce feature allows a Platform Administrator to automate the routing of records to specific users for review and decision-making based on predefined criteria?

options.text: Assignment Rules
Validation Rules
Approval Process
Schema Builder

questions.explanationEs: El approval process es la herramienta para que personas concretas revisen y decidan sobre un registro según criterios: lo bloquea, lo enruta a los aprobadores y ejecuta acciones según se apruebe o se rechace. Las assignment rules solo cambian el propietario.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator is designing a prompt template for a new agent. The agent's purpose is to help service reps troubleshoot technical issues by providing concise, step-by-step instructions. Based on best practices for creating effective prompts, which approach should the administrator use when writing this prompt?

options.text: Write a detailed prompt with multiple nested conditions to cover all the major troubleshooting scenarios.
Use specific technical terms and abbreviations to ensure the AI understands the specialised domain.
Focus on providing high-level, theoretical concepts so the AI has the flexibility to respond creatively.
Use natural, easy-to understand language and clear, concise instructions to guide the AI's behavior.

questions.explanationEs: Las buenas prácticas de prompts piden lenguaje natural y claro, con instrucciones concretas y concisas. Las condiciones anidadas confunden al modelo, la jerga y las abreviaturas pueden malinterpretarse y los conceptos abstractos dan respuestas vagas.

questions.stem: What are three characteristics of a master-detail relationship?

options.text: Permissions for the detail record are set independently of the master.
The master object can be a standard or custom object.
Roll-up summaries are supported in master-detail relationships.
The owner field on the detail records is the owner of the master record.
Each object can have up to five master-detail relationships.

questions.explanationEs: En una relación master-detail, el maestro puede ser estándar o personalizado, admite roll-up summary fields sobre sus detalles, y el detalle no tiene propietario propio: hereda el del maestro y su compartición. Un objeto admite como máximo dos relaciones master-detail.

questions.stem: Universal Containers requires that when an opportunity is closed won, all other open opportunities on the same account must be rendered as Closed Lost. Which automation solution should a Platform Administrator use to implement this request?

options.text: Flow Builder
Outbound Message
Flow Orchestration
Quick Action

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow sobre Opportunity que se dispare al pasar a Closed Won puede buscar las demás oportunidades abiertas de la misma cuenta y ponerlas en Closed Lost. Un outbound message es para sistemas externos, una quick action exige un clic y Flow Orchestration es excesivo para esto.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks is trying to set up a new user but receives an error about a duplicate username when trying to save the user record. What is causing this error to happen?

options.text: The username was not configured in the format of an email address.
The email address and username must be unique across all Salesforce orgs.
The username must be unique across all Salesforce orgs.
The username has a restricted domain name within it.

questions.explanationEs: El username debe ser único en todas las orgs de Salesforce, sean producción, sandboxes o Developer Edition de cualquier empresa, aunque tenga formato de email. El email, en cambio, se puede repetir.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters uses a custom Invoice object to collect customer payment information from an external billing system. The Billing System field needs to be filled in on every Invoice record. How should a Platform Administrator ensure this requirement?

options.text: Create a flow to update the field.
Require the field on the record type.
Define an approval process for the field.
Make the field universally required.

questions.explanationEs: Si el campo debe estar relleno en todos los registros, se creen por la interfaz, por API o desde una integración, hay que marcarlo como obligatorio en la definición del campo. Hacerlo obligatorio solo en el layout o en el record type no afecta a las cargas por API.

questions.stem: An agent is being developed with several actions that all retrieve information from different databases. A Platform Administrator has named the actions as follows: GetCustomerInfo, GetOrderDetails, GetShippingStatus. Which best practice should the administrator follow to improve these names?

options.text: Remove all verbs and use only nouns, such as CustomerInfo, OrderDetails, and ShippingStatus.
Add the word "Salesforce" to the beginning of each action name to improve context for the large language model.
Use a consistent naming convention by starting each action with the verb "Get".
Use additional related verbs, such as Find, Retrieve, or Identify.

questions.reviewNote: El enunciado está mal planteado: pide mejorar unos nombres que ya empiezan todos por «Get», y la respuesta de la fuente es precisamente usar «Get» de forma consistente. Quédate con la idea de fondo: nombres de acción consistentes y descriptivos.
questions.explanationEs: Para que el agente elija bien entre acciones parecidas, sus nombres deben ser claros, descriptivos y consistentes, por ejemplo empezando por el mismo verbo todas las que consultan datos. Quitar los verbos o mezclar sinónimos (Find, Retrieve…) confunde al modelo, y añadir «Salesforce» no aporta contexto.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has three teams of customer service reps that use a custom field on the Case object to populate the team assigned to manage the tickets. The customer support manager would like a Custom Dashboard to show data specific to each team. What should a Platform Administrator do to meet this requirement?

options.text: Create separate Dashboards for each Customer Support team.
Create a Dashboard with widgets specific to each team.
Create a Dashboard that uses Dashboard filters to show specific team data.
Add Cross Filters to switch between the three customer service teams.

questions.explanationEs: Con un dashboard filter sobre el campo de equipo, un único dashboard sirve para los tres equipos: el manager elige el equipo y todos los componentes se actualizan. Mantener varios dashboards iguales es costoso, y los cross filters son de los informes.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks needs to change the owner of a case when it has been open for more than 7 days. What should a Platform Administrator use to complete this requirement?

options.text: Escalation Rules
Auto Response Rules
Assignment Rules
Validation Rules

questions.explanationEs: Una escalation rule con una entrada de 7 días (168 horas) reasigna automáticamente los casos que lleven abiertos más tiempo. Las assignment rules no tienen temporizador, las auto-response rules envían emails al cliente y las validation rules no cambian el propietario.

questions.stem: The Cloud Kicks sales team has asked that two of the fields that appear on the Opportunity cards in Kanban view be changed to make the cards more meaningful. Which feature should a Platform Administrator access to make this change?

options.text: Record Type
Compact Layout
Page Layout
Kanban Settings

questions.reviewNote: Hasta donde sé, en Lightning las tarjetas del Kanban muestran los primeros campos de la list view, no los del compact layout. La fuente da Compact Layout: compruébalo antes de fiarte de esta respuesta.
questions.explanationEs: El compact layout define los campos clave de un objeto que se muestran en la cabecera del registro y en otras vistas resumidas. Hasta donde sé, las tarjetas del Kanban muestran los primeros campos de la list view: lee la nota antes de quedarte con esta respuesta.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks has created an approval process for time-off requests. Which two automated actions are available for the administrator to add as part of the approval process?

options.text: Field Update
Email Alert
Chatter Post
Autolaunched Flow

questions.explanationEs: Las acciones automáticas de un approval process, al enviar, aprobar, rechazar o retirar, pueden ser field updates, email alerts, tasks y outbound messages. Un Chatter post o un flow no están entre ellas.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks has created a screen flow to help service reps ask the same set of questions when customers call in with issues. This screen should be visible from cases. How should the administrator distribute the screen flow?

options.text: Page Layout
Home Page
Lightning Page
Component Filter

questions.explanationEs: Para que el screen flow esté en el caso, se añade el componente Flow a la Lightning record page de Case con Lightning App Builder. En la Home no tendría el contexto del caso, y los filtros de componente solo deciden cuándo se ve.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters has a new flow that automatically sets field values when a new account is created. The flow is launched by a process, but the flow is not working properly. What should a Platform Administrator do to identify the problem?

options.text: View the Setup Audit Trail and review for errors.
Set up email logs and review the send error logs.
Use the native debug feature in Flow Builder.
Review debug logs with the flow logging level.

questions.reviewNote: El enunciado habla de un flow lanzado por un proceso de Process Builder, que ya no tiene soporte (desde el 31/12/2025). La idea de fondo sigue valiendo: para depurar un flow, usa el Debug de Flow Builder.
questions.explanationEs: Para depurar un flow lo más directo es el botón Debug de Flow Builder: simula la ejecución con un registro y muestra paso a paso qué valores toman las variables, qué camino se sigue y dónde falla. Los debug logs también sirven, pero son mucho más difíciles de leer.

questions.stem: Which action should a Platform Administrator configure to reverse a submitted approval request and unlock the associated record when setting up an approval process?

options.text: Final Rejection Actions
Recall Actions
Final Approval Actions
Initial Submission Actions

questions.explanationEs: Las recall actions se ejecutan cuando el remitente o un administrador retira una solicitud de aprobación: lo habitual es devolver el estado a borrador y desbloquear el registro para poder editarlo. Las initial submission actions son las que lo bloquean.

questions.stem: Which feature gives a sales team the ability to prioritize deals with recent updates in the List view and Kanban view?

options.text: Big Deal Alerts
Report Filters
Deal Change Highlights
Opportunity Path

questions.explanationEs: Deal Change Highlights resalta en las list views y en el Kanban los cambios recientes de importe y fecha de cierre, en verde o rojo según suban o bajen, para priorizar las oportunidades que se han movido. Big Deal Alert avisa por email de las oportunidades grandes.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants emails received from customers to generate cases automatically. How should a Platform Administrator ensure that the emails are sent to the correct queue?

options.text: Create an escalation rule to send cases to the correct queue.
Use a custom email service to set the owner of the case upon creation.
Utilize a flow to identify the correct queue and assign the case.
Configure Email-to-Case so emails are delivered to the correct queue.

questions.explanationEs: En Email-to-Case, cada routing address puede tener su propietario de caso por defecto, un usuario o una queue, así que los emails a cada dirección crean casos en la cola correcta. Las escalation rules actúan con el paso del tiempo, no al crear el caso.

questions.stem: A user is unable to relate a task to the Course custom object. What should a Platform Administrator do to allow tasks to be related to courses?

options.text: Create a sharing rule for the Course object to grant the user Read/Write access.
Select Allow Activities on the Course object in Object Manager.
Add the Open Activities related list to the Course page layout.
Update the user's profile to grant them Edit access to the Task object.

questions.explanationEs: Para relacionar tareas y eventos con un objeto personalizado hay que activar Allow Activities en sus propiedades. Añadir la related list sin eso no sirve, y ni la compartición ni los permisos sobre Task habilitan la relación.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Universal Containers is asked to restrict login access for users to specific hours and specific IP addresses to help minimize the risk of bad actors getting into the org. Which setting should the administrator update to accomplish this?

options.text: Company Settings
The user's role
The user's profile
Custom permission sets

questions.explanationEs: Login Hours y Login IP Ranges se configuran en el profile: fuera de ese horario, o desde otra IP, el usuario no puede entrar. Los trusted IP ranges de la org solo evitan la verificación de identidad, y el rol controla la visibilidad de registros.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants a report to categorize accounts into small, medium, and large based on the dollar value found in the Contract Value field. Which feature should a Platform Administrator use to meet this request?

options.text: Group Rows
Filter Logic
Detail Column
Bucket Column

questions.explanationEs: Un bucket column sobre un campo numérico o de divisa crea rangos con nombre (Small, Medium, Large) directamente en el informe, sin campos nuevos. Agrupar filas agruparía por cada importe exacto.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) has a new Platform Administrator who is asked to put together a memo detailing Salesforce usage to budget for upcoming license purchases. Where should the administrator go to find out what type of licenses CK has purchased and how many are available?

options.text: Usage-based entitlements related list in company information
Search for licenses types in setup
User licenses related list in company information
User management settings in setup

questions.explanationEs: En Company Information, la related list User Licenses muestra cada tipo de licencia comprada, cuántas hay, cuántas se usan y cuántas quedan. Usage-based entitlements recoge recursos de consumo, no licencias de usuario.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Universal Containers is trying to deactivate a user who has left the company but is unable to do so. What is preventing the administrator from deactivating this user?

options.text: The user is the running user of a dashboard.
The user is part of an active case assignment rule.
The user is part of an Opportunity team.
The user is part of an Account team.

questions.reviewNote: Hasta donde sé, ser running user de un dashboard no impide desactivar al usuario: el dashboard pasa a dar un error de running user inactivo hasta que lo cambies. Sí bloquean la desactivación otros casos, como estar en un campo de jerarquía personalizado. Trátala con cautela.
questions.explanationEs: Según la fuente, ser running user de un dashboard impide desactivar al usuario, y antes hay que cambiar el running user. Lee la nota: hasta donde sé, la desactivación sí se permite y es el dashboard el que da error después.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters has the Case object set to private. The support manager raised a concern that reps have a broader view of data than expected and can see all cases on their group's dashboards. What is causing reps to have inappropriate access to data on dashboards?

options.text: Dashboard Filters
Public Dashboards
Dashboard's running user
Dashboard Subscriptions

questions.explanationEs: Un dashboard con un running user fijo enseña a todos los datos que ve ese usuario: si es un manager que ve todos los casos, los agentes verán más de lo que les permite el OWD Private. Para que cada uno vea solo lo suyo, el dashboard debe ser dinámico, ejecutado como el usuario que lo mira.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks has a custom picklist field on Lead, which is missing on the Contact when leads are converted. Which two steps should the administrator take to ensure these values are populated?

options.text: Update the picklist value with a validation rule.
Create a custom picklist field on Contact.
Map the picklist field on the Lead to the Contact.
Set the picklist field to be required on the Lead object.

questions.explanationEs: Los campos personalizados de lead solo pasan al convertir si existe un campo equivalente del mismo tipo en el contacto y se mapean en Map Lead Fields. Ni una validation rule ni hacer el campo obligatorio trasladan el dato.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks is setting up a new Salesforce instance. The business requirements mandate that the marketers are given access to opportunities in order to maintain the campaign relationships on each opportunity. The administrator decides to assign the Marketing User profile. What should the administrator do next to achieve this requirement?

options.text: Edit the object permissions to include Opportunity.
Add a custom permission set to include Opportunity.
Edit the role to enable Sales access.
Configure the assigned apps to include Opportunity.

questions.reviewNote: La fuente da como correcta editar los permisos de objeto del perfil Marketing User, pero los permisos de un perfil estándar no se pueden editar (la propia fuente lo reconoce en otra pregunta). Lo coherente es darlos con un permission set.
questions.explanationEs: Los perfiles estándar como Marketing User no permiten editar sus permisos de objeto. Para que los marketers trabajen con oportunidades, lo correcto es mantener su perfil y añadir un permission set con el acceso a Opportunity. El rol no da permisos, y añadir la pestaña a una app no concede acceso al objeto.

questions.stem: A manager wants the sales team to update their opportunities on a regular basis. Which feature should a Platform Administrator implement to help with this?

options.text: Similar Opportunities
Opportunity Update Reminders
Big Deal Alerts
Scheduled Reports

questions.explanationEs: Opportunity Update Reminders envía a los comerciales emails periódicos con sus oportunidades abiertas para que las mantengan al día; los managers lo configuran para su equipo. Un informe programado no está pensado para eso, y Big Deal Alert avisa de las oportunidades grandes.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks has a request from the finance team that all won opportunities over a certain value must be checked for accuracy before the deal can be considered fully closed. The assigned finance team member, as well as the sellers' manager, both must sign off on the deal, with the manager doing so first. Then, the finance team member must sign off, for a total of up to three sign-offs per opportunity. How should the administrator address this request?

options.text: Create a screen flow that runs anytime an opportunity is closed.
Add a Lightning web component to the opportunity page to capture the details in an approval record.
Create a quick action to send emails to both the manager and the finance team member.
Create an approval process with specific steps.

questions.explanationEs: Un approval process con pasos en orden cumple el requisito: el primero va al manager del comercial y, solo si aprueba, el segundo va al miembro de finanzas, con el historial de aprobación como registro. Un screen flow, una quick action con emails o un componente personalizado ni bloquean el registro ni garantizan el orden.

questions.stem: The sales reps at Cloud Kicks should be able to report on each other's account and opportunity records with the organization-wide default for Account and Opportunity both set to Private. What should a Platform Administrator do to achieve this?

options.text: Create an owner-based sharing rule for Accounts with sharing between a Public Group of Sales Reps and Read Only Opportunity Access.
Create an Account and Opportunity report to show any owned by each member of the Sales Team and save the report into a shared report folder.
Utilize Apex sharing to programmatically share records between a group of Sales Rep users.
Create manual sharing to share specific account and opportunity records between the sales reps.

questions.explanationEs: Con OWD Private en cuentas y oportunidades, una sharing rule de propietario que comparta las cuentas de un public group de comerciales con ese mismo grupo, incluyendo lectura sobre sus oportunidades, les permite verse e informar entre ellos. Guardar un informe en una carpeta compartida no da acceso a los registros.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks needs to be able to show different picklist values for sales and marketing users. Which two options meet this requirement?

options.text: Two page layouts, one record type, two picklists
Two permission sets, one record type, one picklist
One record type, two profiles, one picklist
One page layout, two record types, one picklist

questions.explanationEs: Para mostrar valores de picklist distintos a ventas y a marketing, o se usa un único picklist con dos record types (cada uno con sus valores), o se crean dos picklists y cada uno va en el page layout de su equipo. Ni los perfiles ni los permission sets filtran valores de picklist.

questions.stem: How should a Platform Administrator provide users with individualized views of data on a dashboard?

options.text: Add a Dashboard Filter to change the dashboard view.
Create a Dynamic Dashboard.
Set View Dashboard As to Me.
Set View Dashboard As to Another person.

questions.explanationEs: Un dynamic dashboard se ejecuta como el usuario que lo mira, así que cada persona ve sus propios datos según su compartición, sin crear un dashboard por usuario. Fijar el running user en ti o en otra persona hace que todos vean lo mismo.

questions.stem: The sales and service teams at Cloud Kicks would like to have more visibility into their pipeline and stay on top of every case. A Platform Administrator needs to quickly create dashboards for each of the teams but does not know where to start. What should the administrator do?

options.text: Use the Salesforce Labs Field Service Dashboards for service teams from AppExchange.
Enable Einstein Analytics and build custom dashboards using advanced analytics tools.
Use the Salesforce Labs CRM Dashboards for sales teams from AppExchange.
Manually create dashboards without using any prebuilt templates or packages.

questions.explanationEs: Salesforce Labs publica en AppExchange paquetes gratuitos de dashboards, como CRM Dashboards, con componentes de pipeline y de casos listos para usar y adaptar: es la forma más rápida de empezar. Hacerlos a mano lleva más tiempo, y CRM Analytics es otro producto con su propia licencia.

questions.stem: An administrator at DreamHouse Realty needs to create customized pages for the Salesforce mobile app. Which two types of pages should a Platform Administrator build and customize using the Lightning App Builder?

options.text: App page
User page
Record page
Dashboard page

questions.explanationEs: Con Lightning App Builder puedes crear app pages, que se pueden añadir a la navegación móvil, y personalizar record pages, incluso con componentes que solo se vean en el móvil. Los dashboards se crean en su propio editor.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks received a request from the head of sales operations to create a process in which opportunities must be validated by specific team leaders based on a mix of criteria. When the administrator analysed the list of criteria, they found that there were 30 potential sets of criteria that would identify the proper person to route the request to. How should the administrator fulfill this request?

options.text: Create a button on the opportunity that brings up an email template to send to the correct leader.
Create an approval process with specific entry criteria and approval steps for each of the sets of criteria specified.
Create a record triggered flow orchestration to properly route the requests.
Use a screen flow to allow the seller to input the criteria in a form that is then sent to the appropriate leader.

questions.reviewNote: Success4Exam da otra clave para esta misma pregunta: un record-triggered flow orchestration. La de FreeCram es viable porque un approval process admite hasta 30 pasos, cada uno con sus criterios y su aprobador, pero con tantos conjuntos de criterios Flow Orchestration también encaja. Ninguna fuente oficial lo aclara.
questions.explanationEs: Un approval process admite hasta 30 pasos, cada uno con sus propios criterios de entrada y su aprobador, así que puede cubrir los 30 conjuntos de criterios y enrutar cada solicitud al líder correcto sin intervención del comercial. Un botón con plantilla de email o un formulario dependen de que el comercial acierte.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Universal Containers has a screen flow that helps users create new leads. When Lead Source is "Search Engine", the administrator needs to require the user to choose a specific search engine from a picklist. If Lead Source is not "Search Engine", this picklist should be hidden. What is the most efficient way for the administrator to complete this requirement?

options.text: Use a conditional filter in the screen element to only show the Specific Search Engine field only when Lead Source is "Search Engine".
Use Assignment elements; one for when Lead Source is "Search Engine" and one for everything else.
Create a picklist for Specific Search Engine, and set conditional visibility so that it is only shown when Lead Source is "Search Engine".
Configure a picklist for Specific Search Engine, and use a validation rule to conditionally show only when Lead Source is "Search Engine".

questions.explanationEs: En un screen flow, la conditional visibility de un componente hace que solo se muestre cuando se cumple una condición, aquí que Lead Source sea Search Engine, y además se puede marcar como obligatorio. Una validation rule avisaría tarde, al guardar, y los elementos Assignment no muestran ni ocultan campos.

questions.stem: A sales manager receives a URL to a Dashboard folder containing several dashboards. However, when the sales manager clicks on the URL, a message appears stating, "We couldn't find the record you're trying to access." What is the reason for this?

options.text: The sales manager does not have the correct permission set.
The sales manager needs the correct sales user profile.
The Dashboard folder is set to Private.
View access has not been granted to the Dashboard folder.

questions.explanationEs: El acceso a los dashboards se controla por carpeta: aunque tengas la URL, si no te han dado acceso de lectura a la carpeta verás «We couldn't find the record». La solución es compartir la carpeta con el usuario, su rol o un grupo.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has a custom object called Shipments. The company wants to see all the shipment items from an Account page. When an Account is deleted, the shipments should remain. Which type of relationship should a Platform Administrator make between Shipments and Accounts?

options.text: Accounts should have a lookup to Shipments.
Shipments should have a master detail to Accounts.
Shipments should have a lookup to Account.
Accounts should have a master detail to Shipments.

questions.explanationEs: Con un lookup desde Shipment hacia Account, los envíos aparecen en una related list de la cuenta y no se borran al borrar la cuenta. Con master-detail se borrarían en cascada, y la relación se crea siempre en el objeto hijo.
