questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks needs to temporarily remove one dashboard from a shared folder with several dashboards to make some required changes. How should the administrator achieve this?

options.text: Remove View access to the shared folder.
Edit the dashboard properties and move it to a private dashboards folder.
Remove the permission set to the dashboard from the users.
Create a private group and add the dashboard to it.

questions.explanationEs: Mover el dashboard a una carpeta privada, como My Private Dashboards, lo saca de la carpeta compartida mientras lo modificas, sin afectar a los demás dashboards. Quitar el acceso a la carpeta los ocultaría todos.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants Agentforce to adapt its behavior based on real-time customer input. Which feature directly enables this capability?

options.text: Data Cloud
Custom actions
Screen flow
Tableau

questions.explanationEs: Las acciones son lo que permite a Agentforce actuar en tiempo real según lo que dice el cliente: el agente interpreta la intención y elige la acción adecuada (un flow, Apex o una prompt template) con los datos de la conversación. Data Cloud aporta datos para el grounding, pero no define el comportamiento.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator needs to create a new prompt template to automatically summarize customer cases for a sales team. The administrator wants to dynamically populate the response with data from the case record. What should the administrator use to display real Salesforce data in an agent response from a prompt template?

options.text: Flow
Picklists
Agent Instructions
Merge Fields

questions.explanationEs: En Prompt Builder, los merge fields insertan en la plantilla datos reales del registro, como el asunto o la descripción del caso, al ejecutarla. Un flow sirve para recuperar datos más complejos, pero para campos del propio registro lo directo son los merge fields.

questions.stem: Which component of an approval process defines the chain of approval, determines which records can advance, and specifies where to assign approval requests?

options.text: Process Definition Detail
Approval Steps
Entry Criteria
Approval Actions

questions.explanationEs: Los approval steps definen la cadena de aprobación: cada paso decide qué registros entran en él, a quién se asigna la solicitud y si el delegado del aprobador puede responder. Los entry criteria solo filtran la entrada al proceso, y las approval actions son lo que ocurre al aprobar o rechazar.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator is creating a new action instruction for an agent. This action, named createCase, is designed to generate a new Salesforce Case record based on the user's conversation with the agent. Which set of Action Instructions should the administrator use for the createCase action, according to best practices for action instructions?

options.text: "This action provides the ability to create a new case record in the Salesforce system. Its function is to simply save customer information as a record. Use this when the user wants to create a case."

"Use this action to create a new Salesforce Case record. The goal is to document a customer's issue in the system. Use this when the user's intent is to create a formal record of their problem or question."
"Creates a new case record in the system for any type of customer inquiry. The purpose of this is to ensure a record of the interaction is saved."
"The createCase code snippet is configured to create a case. It runs in the background to handle the user' s request to log a new issue. Its purpose is to solve the customer's issue."

questions.explanationEs: Las instrucciones de una acción deben explicar qué hace, para qué sirve y en qué situación usarla. La mejor dice que crea un caso para documentar el problema del cliente y que se usa cuando su intención es dejar constancia formal de él. Las vagas («cualquier consulta») hacen que el agente la use cuando no toca, y hablar de fragmentos de código no ayuda al modelo.

questions.stem: Once an opportunity reaches the negotiation stage at Cloud Kicks, the Amount field becomes required for sales users. Sales managers need to be able to move opportunities into this stage without knowing the amount. How should a Platform Administrator require this field during the negotiation stage for sales users but allow their managers to make changes?

options.text: Make the field required for all users.
Assign the Administrator profile to the managers.
Configure a validation rule to meet the criteria.
Create a formula field to fill in the field for managers.

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule puede combinar datos del registro y del usuario: salta si Stage es Negotiation, Amount está vacío y el perfil del usuario no es el de manager. Hacer el campo obligatorio para todos no deja la excepción para los managers, y darles el perfil de administrador es un riesgo de seguridad.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator creates a custom text area field on the Account object and adds it to the service team's page layout. The service team manager loves the addition of this field and wants it to appear in the highlights panel so that the service reps can quickly find it when on the Account page. How should the administrator accomplish this?

options.text: In the Account object manager, create a custom compact layout.
Make the field required and move it to the top of the page.
Create a new page layout and a new section titled highlights panel.
From the page layout editor, drag the field to the highlights panel.

questions.explanationEs: Los campos del Highlights Panel, la cabecera del registro, vienen del compact layout del objeto: se crea o edita uno en Object Manager y se asigna como principal. El Page Layout Editor no controla esa cabecera.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator wants to customize the navigation menu for users in the Salesforce mobile app. The organization has not yet implemented any Lightning apps for mobile use. Which statement about the Mobile Only app navigation is correct?

options.text: Lightning pages and Visualforce pages automatically appear in the Mobile Only navigation menu without requiring tabs to be created first.
The Mobile Only app can be customized to show different navigation menus for different user profiles and permission sets.
The first four items in the Mobile Only navigation menu appear both in the navigation menu and in the navigation bar at the bottom of the screen.
The Mobile Only app automatically includes all standard Salesforce objects in the navigation menu based on user permissions.

questions.explanationEs: Si no hay apps de Lightning para móvil, la navegación de la app móvil se configura en Salesforce Navigation y es la misma para toda la org; los cuatro primeros elementos aparecen también en la barra inferior. Una página necesita su pestaña para poder añadirse, y para menús distintos por perfil hacen falta apps de Lightning.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to track all stakeholders involved in its sales opportunities to ensure proper relationship management. Sales reps need to identify who has decision-making authority, who influences the buying process, and who serves as the primary contact for each deal. Which feature should a Platform Administrator configure to meet this requirement?

options.text: Configure opportunity team members to track internal and external stakeholders.
Set up account teams to track stakeholders across multiple opportunities.
Use standard fields on opportunities to track stakeholder information.
Use contact roles on opportunities to identify stakeholder involvement and influence.

questions.explanationEs: Las opportunity contact roles relacionan varios contactos con una oportunidad e indican el papel de cada uno (decision maker, influencer…) y cuál es el principal. Los opportunity teams son para personas internas, y los account teams no son específicos de cada oportunidad.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has implemented an Employee Agent to answer benefits questions for its employees. How should a Platform Administrator prevent the agent from responding to staff members' questions about the CEO's private health plan and benefits?

options.text: Configure assignment rules to assign the agent to employee data.
Ensure the users' permissions and field-level security restrict access to the CEO's health plan.
Modify the agent's instructions and guardrails to block questions related to the CEO's health plan.
Train the agent on employee health plans instead of the CEO's health plan.

questions.explanationEs: Los agentes respetan el modelo de seguridad de Salesforce y solo usan datos que el usuario del agente puede ver. Restringir el acceso al plan de salud del CEO con permisos, compartición y field-level security es la protección real; las instrucciones y los guardrails ayudan, pero no son una barrera de seguridad.

questions.stem: A salesperson complains that the Log a Call button is missing from the highlights panel of an Opportunity page. What is the reason for this?

options.text: The Log a Call action will appear within the Activity Component as a standard behavior rather than the highlights panel.
The Log a Call action has not been added to the Salesforce Mobile and Lightning Experience Actions section of the page layout.
The custom Log a Call permission is missing from the user's profile and assigned permission sets.
The custom Log a Call permission has been disabled at the org level in Setup.

questions.explanationEs: Los botones y acciones del Highlights Panel en Lightning salen de la sección Salesforce Mobile and Lightning Experience Actions del page layout: si Log a Call no aparece, hay que añadirla ahí. No existe un permiso específico de Log a Call.

questions.stem: One of the sales managers at Universal Containers will be going on leave for several months. The executives want to make sure the sales manager does not log in to Salesforce while on leave. What should a Platform Administrator do to ensure the user is not able to log in while on leave?

options.text: Reassign the user's license during leave.
Change the Login Hours for the profile.
Freeze the user's account.
Restrict Login IP Addresses for the profile.

questions.explanationEs: Freeze impide al usuario iniciar sesión al momento sin desactivarlo, y se deshace cuando vuelve. Cambiar las Login Hours o las IP del perfil afectaría a todos los usuarios con ese perfil, y liberar su licencia exige desactivarlo.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) is partnering with a used shoe store and second-hand bicycle emporium. CK has an automated business process it wants to run once a week to count the number of open cases related to an Account. Which flow should a Platform Administrator recommend automating within Flow Builder for this business process?

options.text: Scheduled flow
Record triggered flow
Autolaunched flow
Automation event triggered flow

questions.explanationEs: Un proceso que debe ejecutarse una vez por semana es un schedule-triggered flow: se programan la frecuencia y la hora, y puede recorrer las cuentas para contar sus casos abiertos. Un record-triggered flow necesita que cambie un registro, y un autolaunched flow necesita que algo lo invoque.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty (DHR) wants a templated process with a mortgage calculator that generates leads for loans. DHR needs to complete the project within 30 days and has maxed out its budget for the year. Which AppExchange item should help a Platform Administrator meet the request?

options.text: Bolt Solutions
Lightning Community
Lightning Data
Flow Solutions

questions.explanationEs: En AppExchange, las Flow Solutions son flows preconstruidos, muchos gratuitos y de Salesforce Labs, que puedes instalar y adaptar: encajan con un calculador que genere leads, poco plazo y nada de presupuesto. Las Bolt Solutions son plantillas de sitio más completas.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Cloud Kicks needs to export a file of closed won opportunities from the last 90 days. The file should include the Opportunity Name, ID, Close Date, and Amount. What should the administrator use to export this file?

options.text: Data Loader
Data Import Wizard
Data Cloud Connection
Data Export Service

questions.explanationEs: Data Loader permite exportar con una consulta SOQL solo los registros y campos que quieres: Closed Won de los últimos 90 días con nombre, Id, fecha de cierre e importe. La Data Export Service exporta toda la org como copia de seguridad, y el Data Import Wizard es para importar.

questions.stem: Agentforce is escalating cases to the support team, but the support team complains they have no context and have to ask the customer to repeat everything. Which configuration issue is the most likely cause of this issue?

options.text: The support team members are missing the Agentforce User permission set.
The support team's case page layout is missing the agent history component.
The agent's instructions are preventing the history and context from being saved.
The handoff is creating a new case instead of transferring the existing session.

questions.reviewNote: Success4Exam da otra clave para esta misma pregunta: que el traspaso cree un caso nuevo en vez de transferir la sesión, con lo que el agente humano no recibe la conversación. Es tan plausible como la de FreeCram, y ninguna fuente oficial lo aclara.
questions.explanationEs: Si el equipo de soporte recibe el caso sin contexto, lo más probable es que su página de caso no incluya el componente con el historial de la conversación con el agente. Hay que añadirlo a la Lightning record page de Case con Lightning App Builder.

questions.stem: The Universal Containers sales team wants a visual way to manage their opportunity pipeline that allows them to see all deals at once, track progress through sales stages, and quickly move opportunities forward. Which feature should a Platform Administrator recommend to meet these requirements?

options.text: Set up opportunity reports with chart components and stage-based grouping.
Create a custom dashboard with opportunity pipeline charts and stage metrics.
Use the Kanban view for opportunities with card fields and drag-and-drop functionality.
Configure opportunity list views with custom filters and summary fields.

questions.explanationEs: La vista Kanban muestra las oportunidades como tarjetas en columnas por etapa, y se arrastran para cambiar de etapa: se ve todo el pipeline y se avanza rápido. Informes y dashboards resumen, pero no permiten mover registros.

questions.stem: When Agentforce performs its grounding check, it examines source information, the topic instructions, and scope. Which additional information does the agent look for during its grounding check?

options.text: Incompatible data types
Prompt injection risks
Encrypted fields
The web for information verification

questions.explanationEs: Al comprobar su respuesta, además de la información de origen, las instrucciones del topic y su alcance, el agente vigila riesgos de prompt injection: intentos de que ignore sus instrucciones o revele datos. Agentforce no verifica en la web, y los tipos de datos o los campos cifrados se tratan en la capa de acceso a datos.

questions.stem: Which two actions should a Platform Administrator perform with Case escalation rules?

options.text: Send email notifications.
Change the Case Priority.
Reopen the Case.
Reassign the Case.

questions.explanationEs: Las escalation rules pueden reasignar el caso a otro usuario o cola y enviar notificaciones por email. Cambiar la prioridad o reabrir el caso no son acciones de una escalation rule; para eso usarías un flow.

questions.stem: A sales rep has left the company, and a Platform Administrator has been asked to re-assign all their accounts and opportunities to a new sales rep and keep the team as is. Which tool should the administrator use to accomplish this?

options.text: Data Loader
Dataloader.io
Mass Transfer Records
Data Import Wizard

questions.explanationEs: Mass Transfer Records traspasa desde Setup las cuentas y oportunidades de un usuario a otro, con la opción de mantener los account teams y opportunity teams. Data Loader podría cambiar el OwnerId, pero exige exportar, editar y volver a cargar.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to leverage roll-up summaries on the Account object. Which standard object supports this roll-up summary natively?

options.text: Opportunity
Contact
Case
Campaigns

questions.explanationEs: Account admite de forma nativa roll-up summary fields sobre Opportunity, como la suma de importes o el número de oportunidades. Contact y Case se relacionan con Account mediante lookup, así que no admiten roll-ups nativos.

questions.stem: Marketing users at Cloud Kicks have been completing the Lead Source field inconsistently, with values like Web, Website, and Online. To ensure data quality, a Platform Administrator needs to standardize these records. Which Flow should the administrator use to clean up these inconsistent Lead Source values?

options.text: Segment triggered flow
Record triggered flow
Schedule-triggered flow
Screen flow

questions.explanationEs: Para limpiar valores ya guardados en muchos leads, un schedule-triggered flow puede recorrer los que tengan Website u Online y cambiarlos a Web. Un record-triggered flow solo actúa cuando alguien edita el registro, y un screen flow obligaría a hacerlo uno a uno.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to ensure that cases are routed to the right people at the right time, but there is a growing support organization. The business wants to be able to move people around and adjust the work they get without having to request extra assistance or rely on the administrator teams. Which tool allows the business to control its own assignment of work?

options.text: Case Assignment Rules
Email-to-Case
Omni-Channel
Lead Assignment Rules

questions.explanationEs: Omni-Channel enruta el trabajo a los agentes disponibles según su capacidad y su estado de presencia, y los supervisores pueden ver la carga de cada uno y reajustar el reparto sin depender del administrador. Las case assignment rules son reglas fijas que mantiene el administrador.

questions.stem: A sales team is having difficulty understanding which stage their opportunity is in and what the company sales process requires of them in that stage. Which feature should a Platform Administrator implement to help the sales team quickly determine where they are in the sales process and what is required of them?

options.text: Reports & Dashboards
Opportunity Sales Path
Big Deal Alerts
List Views

questions.explanationEs: Path muestra la etapa en la que está la oportunidad y, para cada etapa, los key fields y la Guidance for Success con lo que se espera del comercial. Los informes, las list views o Big Deal Alert no guían el proceso.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to make sure clients are getting the attention they need and cases are not sitting longer than the Service Level Agreement (SLA) it has with its clients. Which standard feature helps route cases to a Tier 2 team if they have not been addressed in a specific amount of time?

options.text: Milestone and Entitlements
Omni Channel Routing
Auto Response Rules
Escalation Rules

questions.explanationEs: Las escalation rules reasignan automáticamente los casos que superan un tiempo sin resolver, por ejemplo a una cola de Tier 2, y notifican a quien corresponda. Milestones y entitlements miden y muestran el cumplimiento del SLA, y Omni-Channel enruta por disponibilidad, no por tiempo transcurrido.

questions.stem: Users at Cloud Kicks are reporting different options when updating a custom picklist on the Opportunity object based on the kind of opportunity. Where should a Platform Administrator update the option in the picklist?

options.text: Related lookup filters
Record type
Picklist value sets
Fields and relationships

questions.explanationEs: Los valores de un picklist que ve cada tipo de oportunidad se configuran en su record type, eligiendo qué valores de la lista maestra están disponibles. Fields and Relationships o el global value set definen la lista completa.

questions.stem: A sales manager at DreamHouse Realty wants sales users to have a quick way to view and update the opportunities in their pipeline expected to close in the next 90 days. What should a Platform Administrator do to accomplish this request?

options.text: Create a custom report and schedule the sales users to receive it each day as a reminder to update their opportunities.
Make a new Sales dashboard and add a component that shows all opportunities that meet the criteria.
Enable Sales Console and show users how to open a tab for each opportunity in the pipeline that meets the requirements.
Create a list view on the Opportunity object and recommend users switch the view to Kanban to edit by drag and drop.

questions.explanationEs: Una list view de oportunidades con cierre en los próximos 90 días, vista en Kanban, enseña el pipeline por etapas y permite actualizarlo arrastrando tarjetas o editando en línea. Un informe programado o un dashboard no permiten actualizar rápido.

questions.stem: The sales director at Cloud Kicks wants to be able to predict upcoming revenue in the next several fiscal quarters so they can set goals and benchmark how reps are performing. Which two features should a Platform Administrator configure?

options.text: Sales Quotas
Forecasting
Opportunity List View
Opportunity Stages

questions.reviewNote: FreeCram da Forecasting y Opportunity Stages. Success4Exam y el Debrief dan Forecasting y Sales Quotas, que es lo que pide el enunciado: prever ingresos y fijar objetivos con los que medir a los comerciales. La opción decía «Sales Quotes», una errata.
questions.explanationEs: Collaborative Forecasting prevé los ingresos de los próximos trimestres a partir del pipeline, y las cuotas (Sales Quotas) fijan el objetivo de cada comercial, con lo que se puede comparar su rendimiento. Las etapas de oportunidad ya existen y no sirven para fijar objetivos, y una list view solo filtra registros.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has hired a new sales executive who wants to implement a document merge solution in Salesforce. How should a Platform Administrator implement this solution?

options.text: Download the solution from AppExchange.
Install a package from the Partner Portal.
Create a managed package in AppExchange.
Configure the package from Salesforce Setup.

questions.explanationEs: Salesforce no trae un motor potente de combinación de documentos, así que lo habitual es instalar una app de generación de documentos de AppExchange, probándola antes en un sandbox. No hace falta crear un paquete propio.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar classifies its accounts as Silver, Gold, or Platinum Level. When a new case is created for a Silver or Gold partner, it should go to the Regular Support Queue. When an account is Platinum Level, it should automatically go to the Priority Support Queue. What should a Platform Administrator use to achieve this?

options.text: Escalation Rules
Assignment Rules
Case Rules
Workflow Rules

questions.explanationEs: Una case assignment rule con dos entradas, Platinum a la Priority Support Queue y Silver o Gold a la Regular Support Queue, reparte los casos nuevos según el nivel de la cuenta. Las escalation rules actúan pasado un tiempo, y «Case Rules» no es una función de Salesforce.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator is adding a new topic to an agent. What is best practice for topic instructions?

options.text: Write the instructions generically to allow the agent maximum flexibility in its reasoning.
Include an extended list of example user questions so the agent can learn from patterns.
Keep instructions as minimal as possible to reduce agent latency.
Add business-specific language rather than plain language.

questions.reviewNote: No está claro que sea la buena práctica: la guía de Agentforce insiste en instrucciones claras y específicas más que en listas largas de preguntas de ejemplo. Además, la explicación original venía contaminada con un mensaje de chatbot. Trátala con cautela.
questions.explanationEs: Según la fuente, la buena práctica es incluir muchas preguntas de ejemplo en las instrucciones del topic para que el agente aprenda los patrones. Lee la nota: la guía de Agentforce insiste sobre todo en instrucciones claras y específicas que no se solapen entre topics.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has the organization wide defaults for Opportunity set to Private. Which two features should a Platform Administrator use to open up access to opportunity records for sales users working on collaborative deals?

options.text: Sharing rules
Sharing set
Role hierarchy
Profiles

questions.explanationEs: Con OWD Private, el acceso a las oportunidades se amplía con la role hierarchy (hacia arriba, a los managers) y con sharing rules (lateral, por propietario o por criterios). Los perfiles dan permisos sobre el objeto, no acceso a registros ajenos, y los sharing sets son para usuarios de Experience Cloud.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks' management team is hoping to increase user productivity by switching to consoles instead of the current traditional Salesforce user interface. What should a Platform Administrator use to implement this request?

options.text: App Builder
Screen Flow
App Manager
Omni-Channel

questions.explanationEs: Las apps de consola se crean en App Manager eligiendo la navegación de tipo Console, o cambiando la de una app que ya existe. Lightning App Builder diseña páginas, no la navegación de la app.

questions.stem:
A new agent is being developed to help customer service reps process customer requests for a replacement product. The agent needs to call an action that takes two inputs:
• productId: An 18 character ID for the product being replaced
• reasonCode: A three-digit code representing the reason for the replacement.
Which set of agent instructions should a Platform Administrator use for these inputs, according to best practices for Agentforce instructions?

options.text: Instructions for productId: "The 18 character ID of the product." Instructions for reasonCode: "A numerical code."

Instructions for productId: "The product ID. Retrieve this from the conversation history or the user's input." Instructions for reasonCode: "The three-digit replacement reason. This is required when the product ID is present."
Instructions for productId: "ID from the product record." Instructions for reasonCode: "Code for the reason."

Instructions for productId: "The 18 character ID of the product. Retrieve this from the conversation history or the user's input. Required." Instructions for reasonCode: "A three-digit code that specifies the reason for replacement. This is required only when the product ID is present."

questions.explanationEs: Las instrucciones de las entradas de una acción deben indicar el formato (18 caracteres, tres dígitos), de dónde sacar el dato (el historial de la conversación o lo que diga el usuario) y cuándo es obligatorio. La más completa cubre todo eso; con las vagas, el agente adivina o pasa datos incompletos.

questions.stem: A sales rep at Ursa Major Solar has launched a series of networking events. They are hosting one event per month and want to be able to report on Campaign ROI by month and series. How should a Platform Administrator set up the Campaign to simplify reporting?

options.text: Create individual Campaigns that all have the same name.
Configure Campaign Member Statuses to record which event Members attended.
Use Campaign Hierarchy where the monthly events roll up to a parent Campaign.
Add different record types for the monthly event types.

questions.explanationEs: Con una campaign hierarchy, cada evento mensual es una campaña hija de una campaña padre que representa la serie: ves el ROI de cada mes y, con los totales de la jerarquía, el de toda la serie. Repetir el nombre o usar record types distintos no resuelve el informe por serie.

questions.stem: The VP of sales at AW Computing would like sales reps to check in with their top account every Monday. The VP would like a dashboard component to show the status of the check-ins. What should a Platform Administrator configure to remind the reps to contact their top account?

options.text: Create a time-based workflow task.
Enable the creation of recurring tasks.
Add the email action to the page layout.
Use a process email alert on the account.

questions.explanationEs: Con las tareas recurrentes activadas, cada comercial puede crear una tarea semanal, cada lunes, para contactar con su cuenta principal; como son tareas normales, se pueden medir en un informe y en un dashboard. Un email o una alerta avisan, pero no dejan un registro que medir.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Universal Containers needs an automated way to delete records based on field values. Which automated solution should the administrator use?

options.text: Flow Builder
Automation Studio
Mass Delete Records
Flow Orchestration

questions.explanationEs: Un schedule-triggered flow puede buscar periódicamente los registros con ciertos valores y borrarlos con un elemento Delete Records. Mass Delete Records es manual, Automation Studio es de Marketing Cloud y Flow Orchestration es para procesos de varios pasos y personas.

questions.stem: A VP of sales needs to report on records owned by individuals in various parts of the role hierarchy. The organization-wide default is set to Private. What should a Platform Administrator configure to achieve this?

options.text: Field-Level Security
Sharing Rules
Permission Sets
Restriction Rules

questions.explanationEs: Con OWD Private, la jerarquía de roles da acceso hacia arriba, pero no a ramas que no cuelgan del VP. Las sharing rules permiten compartir con él (o con su rol o un grupo) los registros de esas otras partes de la jerarquía. La FLS y los permission sets no dan acceso a registros, y las restriction rules lo reducen.

questions.stem: Service reps in a call center do not have assigned desks. They sit at any available desk and use the computer on that desk to access Salesforce. A Platform Administrator has been asked to streamline the login process so the reps do not have to authenticate each time they log in at a different computer. Which function should the administrator use to implement this request?

options.text: Custom Profile
Trusted IP Ranges
Multi-factor Authentication
Permission Set

questions.explanationEs: Los trusted IP ranges de Network Access evitan que se pida un código de verificación a quien entra desde esa red, así que en el call center no habrá que verificar la identidad en cada equipo. Los Login IP Ranges del perfil restringen el acceso, no lo agilizan.

questions.stem: The VP of sales at Cloud Kicks has a standard sales profile and is receiving an error message that prevents them from saving an opportunity. A Platform Administrator attempted the same edit without receiving an error. How should the administrator troubleshoot this issue?

options.text: Log in as a system administrator to troubleshoot.
Use 'Login as' to log in as the user.
Use an AppExchange product to troubleshoot.
Ask the user for their password so the admin can log in as the user.

questions.explanationEs: Con «Login as», el administrador ve exactamente lo que ve el usuario, con su perfil, sus permisos y su compartición, que es lo que suele explicar un error que el admin no reproduce, como una validation rule o la FLS. Pedirle la contraseña nunca es aceptable.

questions.stem: In an approval process, what happens when a queue is selected as the approver?

options.text: The queue requires unanimous approval from all of its members before the record is approved.
Any member of the queue can approve or reject the record and the queue is treated as a single entity.
Only the queue owner is notified about the approval request, not its members.
The queue can only be used for objects that do not support individual user approvals.

questions.explanationEs: Si el aprobador es una queue, se avisa a sus miembros y cualquiera de ellos puede aprobar o rechazar: la primera respuesta cuenta como la de la queue. La aprobación unánime es una opción para varios aprobadores individuales.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has set the organization-wide default settings for accounts to private. Amy and Bob are on separate sales teams but are assigned to the same role in the hierarchy. Amy is a member of the "Sales West" public group and needs access to all accounts owned by Bob, a member of the "Sales East" public group. How would Amy obtain access to only Bob's accounts?

options.text: Add Amy to the "Sales East" public group.
Create a sharing rule between the "Sales West" and "Sales East" public groups.
Add Amy to the role above Bob in the role hierarchy.
Add Amy to Bob's account teams.

questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de cuentas en Private, el acceso a las cuentas de un propietario concreto se da con Account Teams: si Bob añade a Amy a sus account teams (o a su default account team), Amy ve solo las cuentas de Bob. Una sharing rule entre «Sales West» y «Sales East» compartiría las cuentas de todo el grupo, no solo las de Bob; meter a Amy en «Sales East» no le da acceso por sí solo, y subirla de rol le abriría todo lo que cuelga por debajo.

learnMore.title: Collaborate on Accounts by Using Teams

questions.stem: A system administrator has gotten a request from the Accounts Payable team for new fields to capture additional details on customer contracts. There are several standard fields on the contract object already that could possibly be used instead of creating new fields. What customization options are available for those standard fields?

options.text: Delete standard fields
Change the field type of standard fields
Remove non-required standard fields from a page layout
Rename standard field labels in the user interface

questions.explanationEs: Los campos estándar no se pueden borrar ni cambiar de tipo. Lo que sí puedes hacer es quitarlos del page layout si no son obligatorios y cambiar su etiqueta con Rename Tabs and Labels, de modo que se adapten al proceso sin crear campos nuevos.

learnMore.title: Work with Standard and Custom Fields

questions.stem: A system administrator at Universal Containers incorrectly imported a set of lead records from a .csv file they received from the Marketing Manager. They need to remove some of the records from Salesforce quickly before users begin to work with the incorrect records. Which tool should the administrator use to complete the task?

options.text: Salesforce roll-back
Data Loader
Mass Delete
Import Wizard

questions.explanationEs: Deshacer la importación es borrar los registros creados: Mass Delete Records lo hace desde Setup para leads y otros objetos estándar comunes, y Data Loader puede borrarlos en bloque con el fichero de éxito de la importación, que trae sus Id. No existe un «roll-back» de importaciones, y el Data Import Wizard solo inserta o actualiza.

questions.stem: The Marketing team at Universal Containers is responsible for creating new leads and distributing them to different regional sales groups for qualification. How can a system administrator automate this process?

options.text: Create a queue for the marketing team and a flow to notify the team each time a lead is assigned to the queue.
Create a queue for each regional group and a lead assignment rule to route leads to the queues.
Create a default sales team for each regional group and a lead assignment rule to route leads to the default sales team.
Create a queue for each regional group and a validation rule to enforce that the leads are assigned to the correct group.

questions.explanationEs: Las lead assignment rules reparten los leads automáticamente según criterios, y una queue por grupo regional hace de bandeja compartida de la que cada equipo toma los suyos. Una validation rule no asigna nada, y los default sales teams (opportunity teams) no reciben leads.

questions.stem: What does the report type determine when a new report is created?

options.text: The objects included in the report
Whether the report can be displayed in a dashboard
The default columns in the report
Whether the report can contain a chart

questions.explanationEs: El report type define qué objetos y relaciones entran en el informe y qué campos tiene disponibles, incluidas las columnas por defecto. Que el informe pueda llevar gráfico o ir en un dashboard depende de su formato (por ejemplo, agrupado), no del report type.

questions.stem: Universal Finance has segmented its customer base into two categories: High Wealth and Retirement. High Wealth accounts should be visible to the High Wealth sales team members only. Retirement accounts should be visible to all sales users. How can a system administrator accomplish this?

options.text: Create a new profile for Retirement sales team members and remove read access to High Wealth account records.

Set the organization-wide default sharing to private and create sharing rules to share High Wealth accounts with the High Wealth team members public group and Retirement accounts with all sales users.
Create a new record type for the High Wealth accounts and share the record type with High Wealth sales team members.
Set the organization-wide default sharing to public read-only and create a sharing rule to limit access to High Wealth accounts.

questions.explanationEs: Para que unas cuentas solo las vea un equipo y otras las vean todos, se parte de lo más restrictivo, OWD Private, y se abre el acceso con sharing rules por criterio: las High Wealth para el grupo de ese equipo y las Retirement para todos los comerciales. Las sharing rules solo amplían acceso, nunca lo restringen, y ni los perfiles ni los record types deciden qué registros se ven.

questions.stem: An administrator needs to prevent users from exporting reports. Which tools could the admin use to accomplish this request?

options.text: User Record
Permission Set
Profile
Muting Permission Set in Group

questions.explanationEs: El permiso Export Reports llega por perfil o por permission set. Para quitarlo hay que desmarcarlo en el profile o, si viene dentro de un permission set group, anularlo con un muting permission set en ese grupo. Un permission set suelto solo suma permisos y el registro del usuario no los controla.

questions.stem: A system administrator is creating new user records for a new hire class starting next week for the Service team. The first few records created with no issues, but this last one is not saving properly. What could be the issue?

options.text: The username is not unique.
The time zone is different from the corporate default.
The Manager field is left blank.
A license is not available.

questions.explanationEs: Un usuario nuevo no se guarda si su username ya existe en cualquier org de Salesforce (debe ser único a nivel global) o si no quedan licencias del tipo elegido. Una zona horaria distinta o el campo Manager vacío no impiden guardarlo.

questions.stem: Universal Containers set the organization-wide default settings for account to private. The system administrator has added a new role to the role hierarchy. Users assigned to the new role need read access to accounts owned by other members of the role. How can an administrator accomplish this?

options.text: Select Grant Access Using Hierarchies for accounts.
Add the role to the account teams.
Create an account sharing rule.
Create a public group for the role.

questions.explanationEs: Con OWD Private, los usuarios de un mismo rol no ven los registros de sus compañeros, porque la jerarquía solo da acceso hacia arriba. Una sharing rule de propietario que comparta las cuentas de ese rol con el propio rol les da la lectura que necesitan. Grant Access Using Hierarchies solo afecta al acceso hacia arriba.

questions.stem: The Support team has a case record type for refund requests. The account owner should be notified when a refund request is entered for one of their accounts. What tool would the administrator use to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Assignment Rules
Flow
Chatter Post
Escalation Rules

questions.explanationEs: Avisar al propietario de la cuenta cuando entra un caso de un record type concreto es un record-triggered flow con una acción de email. Las assignment y escalation rules gestionan quién es el propietario del caso, y un Chatter post no es una herramienta de automatización.

questions.stem: Sales representatives at Universal Containers perform the initial steps in the lead qualification process and sales managers complete the final qualification steps. Universal Containers' requirements include those listed below: Sales managers can access all lead status values. Sales representatives can only access the first three lead status values. Sales representatives cannot access the final two lead status values. How can a system administrator meet these requirements?

options.text: Use field-level security to restrict access to the lead status values.
Create two separate page layouts.
Create two separate lead processes and record types.
Create a validation rule to prevent lead conversion.

questions.explanationEs: Para que distintos usuarios vean distintos valores de Lead Status se crean dos lead processes, cada uno con su subconjunto de valores, y se asocia cada uno a un record type asignado por perfil. La field-level security oculta el campo entero, no algunos valores, y un page layout no filtra picklists.

learnMore.title: Tailor Business Process to Different Record Types

questions.stem: It's important for Universal Containers to always convey a consistent message. When marketing reps talk with leads, they should follow a specific script written by the marketing manager. An administrator is planning to take the script and create a flow with it. What flow element would an administrator use to present the script?

options.text: Screen
Loop
Assignment
Variable

questions.explanationEs: El elemento Screen de un screen flow muestra información y recoge datos del usuario, así que es el que sirve para presentar el guion. Loop, Assignment y Variable son lógica y datos internos que el usuario no ve.

questions.stem: Silvio, the team leader of the LACA regional sales team, has asked that his sales team have the ability to view the number of open opportunities related to each of their accounts while viewing the account record. Currently they have to scroll to find that information and are reporting this is taking valuable time while they are on the phone with a customer. Silvio wants to do everything we can to help his team meet their quotas this quarter. How can a system administrator accomplish this?

options.text: Create a new account record type
Create a custom formula field
Create a roll-up summary field
Create a lookup field from accounts to opportunities

questions.explanationEs: Account y Opportunity tienen una relación de tipo master-detail, así que en la cuenta se puede crear un roll-up summary field que cuente las oportunidades abiertas (con un filtro por IsClosed). Un formula field no puede agregar registros hijos, y un record type o un lookup no calculan nada.

questions.stem: The Accounts Payable team would like to automate the creation of an invoice record on a custom object when an opportunity is marked as Closed Won. Which automation tools could be considered for this requirement?

options.text: Validation Rule
Auto-Response Rule
Flow Builder
Assignment Rule

questions.explanationEs: Crear una factura cuando una oportunidad pasa a Closed Won es un record-triggered flow con un elemento Create Records. Validation rules, auto-response rules y assignment rules no crean registros de otros objetos.

questions.stem: An administrator has imported a file of leads and noticed that some records failed during the import. What could have caused this?

options.text: Locale Settings were incorrect
A required field was not in the import file
The owner was not assigned
A custom validation rule was enforced

questions.explanationEs: Un registro falla al importar si incumple las reglas de la org: le falta un campo obligatorio o lo bloquea una validation rule. Que no venga propietario no hace fallar la importación (por defecto es quien importa).

questions.stem: Which tools can be used to give an end user permissions in Salesforce?

options.text: Profiles
Role Hierarchy
Permission Set Groups
Public Groups

questions.explanationEs: Los permisos de un usuario vienen de su profile y de los permission sets o permission set groups que tenga asignados. La role hierarchy y los public groups afectan a qué registros ve, no a lo que puede hacer.

questions.stem: The Support team at Universal Containers wants to reassign ownership of cases related to a new product that have not been resolved after 3 hours. These cases should be owned by Tier 2 Agents. The Service Managers are also asking to be notified when/if a case changes ownership. What Salesforce tool can an administrator use to most efficiently meet these requirements?

options.text: Create an Escalation Rule
Use Flow to reassign ownership of cases related to that product and send an email to the Service Managers
Create a case assignment rule to reassign ownership of cases related to that product and a flow to send an email to the Service Managers
Create a process using Process Builder to reassign ownership of cases related to that product and send an email to the Tier 2 Agents

questions.explanationEs: Una escalation rule reasigna automáticamente los casos de ese producto que siguen sin resolver pasadas 3 horas a la cola o al usuario de Tier 2, y puede avisar a la vez a los Service Managers, sin construir ninguna automatización. Las assignment rules solo actúan al crear o editar el caso, y Process Builder ya no tiene soporte.

learnMore.title: Create a Process for Managing Support Cases

questions.stem: The Service team is reporting that case records are getting cluttered with components that are not always relevant. They want a more efficient interface with the most frequently used components at the top of the page. How can a system administrator accomplish this?

options.text: Use Lightning App Builder to rearrange and/or remove the components.
Create a page layout, service process, and record type for the case object.
Use Page Layout Editor to rearrange the fields and sections.
Create a Flow to make the components conditionally visible.

questions.explanationEs: Qué componentes tiene la página de registro de Lightning y en qué orden se edita con Lightning App Builder. El Page Layout Editor ordena campos, secciones y related lists dentro del detalle, pero no los componentes de la página.

questions.stem: Which statement about the Salesforce Mobile App is false?

options.text: Custom fields, objects, record types and page layouts are not available on the Mobile App.
Salesforce can be accessed from the browser on a mobile device.
You can change an opportunity's price book.
You can create mobile-specific pages using the Lightning App Builder.

questions.explanationEs: La afirmación falsa es que los campos, objetos, record types y page layouts personalizados no están disponibles en la app móvil: la app de Salesforce sí los muestra. Lo demás es cierto: se puede usar Salesforce desde el navegador del móvil, cambiar el price book de una oportunidad y crear páginas para móvil con Lightning App Builder.

questions.stem: A purchase order requisition is going through the Flow approval process. For amounts over $10,000 a group of managers must all review and agree to the approval. What does the administrator need to set on the approval to make this happen?

options.text: Approve or reject based on the first response
Set the first response approval from all selected approvers
Require unanimous approval when configuring the approval step
Formula fields can reference themselves in the formula

questions.explanationEs: En un Flow Approval Process, cuando un paso se asigna a un grupo de aprobadores puedes exigir aprobación unánime: el registro solo avanza si todos aprueban. Aprobar con la primera respuesta es justo lo contrario, y que una fórmula pueda referenciarse a sí misma no tiene que ver con las aprobaciones.

learnMore.title: Automate Your Approvals with Flow Approval Processes
Require Unanimous Approval for Approval Steps Assigned to Groups

questions.stem: Account has a relationship with which of the following objects?

options.text: Opportunity.
Contact.
Campaign.
Positions.

questions.explanationEs: Account es el objeto central: se relaciona directamente con Contact (las personas de la empresa) y con Opportunity (sus posibles ventas). Campaign se relaciona con leads y contactos a través de Campaign Member, y «Positions» no es un objeto estándar.

questions.stem: Which of the clouds helps your customers manage support information, connect with their customers for help, and resolve tough cases?

options.text: Sales Cloud.
Service Cloud.
Marketing Cloud.
Commerce Cloud.

questions.explanationEs: Service Cloud es la solución de atención al cliente: casos, knowledge y canales de soporte. Sales Cloud cubre las ventas, Marketing Cloud las campañas y Commerce Cloud el comercio electrónico.

questions.stem: Which tool can admins use to view what objects are in their org and how they are related to one another?

options.text: App Launcher.
Setup.
Schema Builder.
Object Manager.

questions.explanationEs: Schema Builder dibuja los objetos de la org, sus campos y cómo se relacionan entre sí. Object Manager sirve para configurar cada objeto, pero no muestra el modelo de datos de forma gráfica.

questions.stem: Which tool lets admins access object management settings for both standard and custom objects?

options.text: Object Manager.
Setup.
App Launcher.
Schema Builder.

questions.explanationEs: Object Manager, en Setup, reúne la configuración de todos los objetos estándar y personalizados: campos, page layouts, record types, validation rules… Schema Builder es una vista gráfica y App Launcher sirve para cambiar de app.

questions.stem: With identity verification, what happens when a user logs in from outside a trusted IP range?

options.text: The user is denied access to Salesforce.
The user must also log in through a social media platform to continue.
The user is sent a verification code that they must enter in order to continue.
None of the above.

questions.explanationEs: Con identity verification, si el usuario entra desde fuera de los trusted IP ranges (y desde un navegador que no está verificado), Salesforce le pide un código de verificación para continuar. Denegarle el acceso es lo que harían los Login IP Ranges del perfil.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a standard fiscal year?

options.text: August 15 - August 14.
July 1 - June 30.
February 1 - January 31.
January 1 - December 31.

questions.explanationEs: Un año fiscal estándar siempre empieza el día 1 de un mes y dura doce meses; solo eliges el mes de inicio. Del 15 de agosto al 14 de agosto no cumple eso y necesitaría un año fiscal personalizado.

questions.stem: User locale settings are initially inherited from where?

options.text: CEO Profile.
Corporate Locale settings.
Salesforce license settings.
System Admin user.

questions.explanationEs: Al crear un usuario, su locale, idioma y zona horaria se toman de la configuración de la empresa (Company Information); después cada usuario puede cambiarlos en su configuración personal.

questions.stem: What is true about working with multiple currencies in Salesforce?

options.text: New users inherit the corporate currency.
Exchange rates can be updated manually or can be automated.
A user's personal currency can be modified.
All of the above.

questions.explanationEs: Las tres afirmaciones son ciertas: los usuarios nuevos heredan la divisa corporativa como divisa personal, los tipos de cambio se pueden actualizar a mano o de forma automática (por ejemplo, vía API) y cada usuario puede cambiar su divisa personal.

questions.stem: What defines how users access objects and data, and what they can do within the application?

options.text: User Profile
Email Address
Username
User Title

questions.explanationEs: El profile define qué puede hacer un usuario: a qué objetos y campos accede, qué permisos de sistema tiene y qué apps y pestañas ve. El email, el username o el puesto no controlan el acceso.

questions.stem: Which of these would be used to give the minimum settings and permissions to a particular user?

options.text: Standard User Profile
Read Only Profile
Minimum Access Profile
Executive Profile

questions.explanationEs: El perfil Minimum Access – Salesforce da los mínimos permisos posibles; la buena práctica es asignarlo y añadir lo necesario con permission sets (mínimo privilegio). Standard User, Read Only o un perfil de dirección dan bastante más.

questions.stem: Admins can assign permission sets to individual users to accomplish what?

options.text: Giving a manager access to their direct reports' records.
Granting an individual more access than their profile allows.
Removing access that a certain individual should not have on their profile.
Permission sets can only be assigned to groups of users.

questions.explanationEs: Los permission sets suman permisos: sirven para dar a un usuario concreto más acceso del que le da su perfil, sin crear un perfil nuevo. No quitan permisos (eso lo hacen los muting permission sets dentro de un grupo), no dan acceso a registros de subordinados y sí se asignan a usuarios individuales.

questions.stem: Why are permission set groups useful?

options.text: They allow admins to bundle permissions together based on a user's salesforce role.
They are a scalable and secure solution to more efficiently manage user permissions.
They allow admins to bundle permission sets together and assign based on a user's job function.

questions.explanationEs: Los permission set groups agrupan varios permission sets para asignarlos de una vez según la función del puesto, lo que hace la gestión de permisos más escalable y segura. No dependen del rol de Salesforce, que controla la visibilidad de registros.

questions.stem: What feature sets the default level of access users have to records they do not own, in each object?

options.text: Role Hierarchy
Sharing Rules
Manager Groups
Org Wide Defaults

questions.explanationEs: Los Organization-Wide Defaults fijan, para cada objeto, el acceso por defecto a los registros que no son tuyos (Private, Public Read Only o Public Read/Write). La jerarquía de roles y las sharing rules solo amplían ese acceso.

questions.stem: True or False: Your role hierarchy must match your org chart.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationEs: Es falso: la role hierarchy no tiene que copiar el organigrama, sino reflejar quién necesita ver los datos de quién. Suele parecerse, pero puedes simplificarla o agrupar puestos según las necesidades de acceso.

questions.stem: At NTO, product managers do not have access to opportunities. How can an admin grant them access to opportunities if they are assisting with a specific deal?

options.text: Change the opportunity OWD to public.
Create a sharing rule to give them access to those opportunities.
Add them to the opportunity team for those opportunities they are assisting on.
Put the product managers in a public group that is used in a sharing rule.

questions.explanationEs: Para dar acceso solo a las oportunidades en las que alguien colabora, se le añade al opportunity team de esas oportunidades con el nivel de acceso necesario. Hacer público el OWD o crear sharing rules abriría muchas más oportunidades de las necesarias.

questions.stem: What is true about sharing rules?

options.text: Rules can be based on ownership or on criteria of records.
You can write a sharing rule to share with a profile.
Rules are not unique to each object in your org.
They are necessary when using a public data access model.

questions.explanationEs: Las sharing rules se basan en el propietario del registro o en criterios de sus campos. Comparten con roles, roles y subordinados o grupos, pero no con perfiles; se definen objeto por objeto, y no hacen falta si el OWD ya es público.

questions.stem: What is a key difference between standard and custom fields?

options.text: You can only modify custom fields.
Standard fields cannot be deleted.
You cannot hide standard fields using field level security.
You can change the field names of standard fields.

questions.explanationEs: La diferencia clave es que los campos estándar no se pueden borrar, y los personalizados sí. Ambos se pueden ocultar con field-level security, y de los estándar puedes cambiar algunas cosas, como la etiqueta o los valores de picklist, pero no su nombre de API.

questions.stem: Support Agents at NTO need to track the product type and series when creating cases. How can an admin ensure that the product type selected determines the values available for the series?

options.text: Create a series field as a controlling picklist and the product type field as a dependent picklist.
Create the product type field as a controlling picklist and the series field as a dependent picklist.
Create a lookup field from the product object to the series object.
Create a multi-select picklist field that includes values for both product type and series.

questions.explanationEs: En las dependent picklists, el campo que manda es el controlling y el que se filtra es el dependiente: Product Type debe ser el controlling y Series el dependent. Una multi-select picklist o un lookup no filtran unos valores según otros.

questions.stem: NTO populates the Industry field on each account record. This value should display on related opportunity records and update when the value is updated on the account record. How can an admin configure this?

options.text: Create a lookup field on the opportunity object.
Create a cross-object formula field on the account object.
Create a rollup summary field on the account object.
Create a cross-object formula field on the opportunity object.

questions.explanationEs: Un cross-object formula field en Opportunity puede mostrar Account.Industry y se actualiza solo, porque se calcula al leerse. La fórmula va en el objeto donde quieres ver el dato, la oportunidad; un roll-up summary agrega datos de los hijos en el padre, no al revés.

questions.stem: True or False: If a field is deleted you have 30 days to restore it from the Deleted Fields section of the Object Manager.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationEs: Es falso: un campo personalizado borrado se puede restaurar durante 15 días, no 30, desde Deleted Fields en Object Manager. Pasado ese plazo desaparece definitivamente.

questions.stem: True or False: If I create a page layout, I have to create a record type.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationEs: Es falso: puedes tener varios page layouts asignados por perfil sin crear ningún record type. Los record types hacen falta cuando quieres procesos o valores de picklist distintos, o asignar layouts por perfil y tipo de registro.

questions.stem: Which of the following does not require a business process to be created?

options.text: A new case record type.
A new account record type.
A new opportunity record type that uses only four of eight stage values.
A new lead record type.

questions.explanationEs: Solo tienen business process Opportunity (sales process), Case (support process), Lead (lead process) y Solution. Account no tiene, así que un record type de cuenta no lo necesita.

questions.stem: Why are record types useful?

options.text: They allow users to access multiple page layouts per object.
They allow unique data to be gathered for different business scenarios
They can be assigned to users via their profiles or permission sets.
All of the above.

questions.explanationEs: Las tres son ciertas: los record types permiten usar distintos page layouts en un mismo objeto, recoger datos distintos para cada escenario de negocio (con sus propios valores de picklist) y se asignan mediante perfiles o permission sets.

questions.stem: An Admin can use the Page Layout Editor tool to do what?

options.text: Make fields required.
Group fields together in sections.
Rearrange related lists.
All of the above.

questions.explanationEs: Con el Page Layout Editor puedes marcar campos como obligatorios en ese layout, agruparlos en secciones y reordenar las related lists: todas las afirmaciones son ciertas.

questions.stem: Why would a user choose Import Wizard over Data Loader?

options.text: Import greater than 50,000 records at a time.
Choose whether to trigger workflow rules.
Prevent duplicate records from entering the system.
Import data for all standard and custom objects.

questions.explanationEs: El Data Import Wizard tiene dos ventajas sobre Data Loader: te deja elegir si se disparan las workflow rules y los procesos al importar, y comprueba duplicados al importar cuentas, contactos y leads. Más de 50 000 registros o cualquier objeto es terreno de Data Loader.

questions.stem: Why would a user choose Data Loader over Import Wizard?

options.text: Choose whether or not to run validation rules.
Export or delete data.
Import opportunity records and prevent duplicates.
A csv file is not needed.

questions.explanationEs: Data Loader también exporta y borra registros, cosa que el Data Import Wizard no hace. Las validation rules se aplican con las dos herramientas, ambas trabajan con CSV y la prevención de duplicados es una ventaja del wizard.

questions.stem: Why might an import or update fail, regardless of the tool used?

options.text: Data validation rules are not met.
A value is entered that does not exist on a unrestricted picklist.
The file is more than 50,000 rows.
The owner field is blank.

questions.explanationEs: Con cualquier herramienta, la carga respeta las reglas de la org: si un registro incumple una validation rule, falla. Un valor nuevo en una picklist no restringida se acepta, y el límite de 50 000 filas es solo del Data Import Wizard.

questions.stem: My org has a LOT of data and needs to be backed up daily. What is my best option?

options.text: Explore third party options on AppExchange.
Regular exports from Import Wizard.
Run reports regularly.
Data Export Service.

questions.explanationEs: La Data Export Service solo se programa semanal o mensualmente, así que para copias diarias de mucho volumen lo adecuado es una solución de backup de AppExchange (o el producto de backup de Salesforce). Informes y exportaciones manuales no son una estrategia de copias de seguridad.

questions.stem: When a lead is converted, which records are automatically created to store the information from the lead record?

options.text: Campaign.
Case.
Account.
Contact.

questions.explanationEs: Al convertir un lead se crean siempre una cuenta y un contacto (o se asocian a unos que ya existen) y, si quieres, una oportunidad. No se crean campañas ni casos.

questions.stem: The sales team at NTO creates and distributes leads to different regional sales groups for qualification. How can an admin automate this process?

options.text: Create a marketing team queue and a workflow alert to notify the team when a new lead has been assigned.
Create a queue for each regional group and a lead assignment rule to route leads to appropriate queues.
Create a public group for each regional team and a lead assignment rule to route the records.
Create a queue for each regional group and a validation rule to enforce correct lead assignment.

questions.explanationEs: Una queue por grupo regional y una lead assignment rule que reparta según la región automatizan la distribución. Los public groups no pueden ser propietarios de leads, y una validation rule no asigna nada.

questions.stem: An escalation rule has just been applied to an NTO support case. Which of the following could happen as a result of the escalation rule?

options.text: The support manager is notified and the case status is set to New.
The case is added to a weekly report outlining overdue cases.
The case is reassigned to another support agent and the support manager is notified.
The customer is emailed a notification that the case is delayed.

questions.explanationEs: Una escalation rule puede reasignar el caso a otro agente o cola y enviar notificaciones, por ejemplo al manager. No cambia el estado, no mete el caso en informes y no avisa al cliente.

questions.stem: When entering data for a new distributor account, a sales rep forgets to format the email address field properly. He receives an error and is unable to save the record. What is preventing him from saving the record?

options.text: System Data Validation.
Organization Wide Defaults.
Assignment Rule.
Queue Ownership.

questions.explanationEs: Los campos de tipo Email validan su formato automáticamente: es una validación de datos del sistema, no una regla que alguien haya creado. Los OWD, las assignment rules o las queues no intervienen al guardar.

questions.stem: When working with customers over the phone, support users want the ability to quickly enter the minimum amount of information needed to create a case record. What kind of flow could be created for this need?

options.text: Record-Triggered Flow.
Auto-Launched Flow.
Screen Flow.
Platform Event-Triggered Flow.

questions.explanationEs: Para que el agente rellene lo mínimo mientras habla con el cliente hace falta una interfaz guiada, es decir, un screen flow. Los record-triggered, autolaunched y platform event-triggered flows se ejecutan en segundo plano, sin pantallas.

questions.stem: Record-Triggered Flows can perform what actions?

options.text: Update Fields.
Send Emails.
Create Tasks.
All of the above.

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow puede actualizar campos, enviar emails y crear tareas (u otros registros) cuando se crea, actualiza o borra un registro: todas son ciertas.

questions.stem: Which of the following is not a way to categorize flow elements?

options.text: Creation.
Logic.
Interaction.
Data.

questions.explanationEs: En Flow Builder los elementos se agrupan en Interaction (pantallas y acciones), Logic (decisiones, asignaciones, bucles) y Data (crear, obtener, actualizar y borrar registros). «Creation» no es una categoría.

questions.stem: What does the Order of Execution refer to?

options.text: The order in which a lead becomes associated to a contact and account.
The order in which rules and automations occur when a user attempts to save a record.
The order of how automations can be created in Salesforce.
The rules surrounding which user permissions are needed to execute Salesforce functionality.

questions.explanationEs: El order of execution es el orden en que Salesforce aplica validaciones, flows, triggers y demás automatizaciones al guardar un registro. Conocerlo ayuda a entender por qué una automatización ve o no un valor.

questions.stem: Why would an Admin need to build a custom object?

options.text: To rename the Opportunity object to Deals.
To store business data in Salesforce that does not yet exist.
To add a report chart to a page layout.
To be more specific when building a report.

questions.explanationEs: Un objeto personalizado sirve para guardar datos de negocio que no encajan en ningún objeto estándar. Para renombrar Opportunity basta con Rename Tabs and Labels, y los informes y gráficos no requieren objetos nuevos.

questions.stem: True or False: You work with outbound change sets in your Source environment and inbound change sets in the Target environment.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationEs: Es cierto: el outbound change set se crea y se sube desde la org de origen (por ejemplo, un sandbox) y llega como inbound change set a la de destino, donde se valida y se despliega.

questions.stem: What is the first step when managing configuration changes in Salesforce?

options.text: Create the outbound change set.
Deploy change set in the Production org.
Configure/Test changes in the Sandbox.
Create the inbound change set.

questions.explanationEs: Primero se configuran y prueban los cambios en un sandbox; después se empaquetan en un outbound change set, se suben y se despliegan en producción como inbound change set.

questions.stem: Just before deploying an inbound change set, what action should an Admin take?

options.text: Configure the change in Production.
Test the inbound change set.
Upload the inbound change set.
Validate the inbound change set.

questions.explanationEs: Antes de desplegar un inbound change set conviene validarlo: Salesforce simula el despliegue y avisa de errores sin aplicar nada. Los cambios no se configuran directamente en producción.

questions.stem: What report format allows for up to four levels of groupings in a grid?

options.text: Summary.
Matrix.
Pivot.
Tabular.

questions.explanationEs: Los informes Matrix agrupan por filas y por columnas a la vez, hasta dos agrupaciones en cada eje (cuatro en total), en forma de cuadrícula. Summary agrupa solo por filas, Tabular no agrupa y «Pivot» no es un formato de informe de Salesforce.

questions.stem: What is determined by the running user of the dashboard?

options.text: What data viewers of the dashboard will see.
Which users can access the dashboard.
Which users can access the source report(s) for the dashboard.
Which users can refresh the dashboard.

questions.explanationEs: El running user determina qué datos ve todo el que abre el dashboard, porque se muestran con su visibilidad. Quién puede abrir el dashboard depende de la carpeta en la que esté.

questions.stem: True or False: You can attach a CSV file to a subscribed report.

options.text: True
False

questions.explanationEs: Es cierto: al suscribirte a un informe puedes pedir que el email incluya el informe como archivo adjunto, por ejemplo en CSV.

questions.stem: Opportunities are private in the NTO org. What will a sales rep see when they click on an opportunity source report from a dashboard component?

options.text: Only opportunities that the running user of the dashboard can access.
Only opportunities that the sales rep can access.
Only opportunities that the running user of the report can access.
All opportunities in the org.

questions.explanationEs: Al pulsar un componente, el informe de origen se abre con la visibilidad de quien lo mira, no con la del running user. Con oportunidades privadas, el comercial solo verá las suyas y las que le hayan compartido.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator at Ursa Major Solar has been asked to change the Work Item and Project custom object relationship from a master-detail to a lookup. Which scenario prevents the administrator from fulfilling this requirement?

options.text: A junction object is required to support the lookup.
Roll-up summary fields exist on the master object.
The lookup field is required for saving records.
The lookup field in all the records contains a value.

questions.explanationEs: Un master-detail no se puede convertir en lookup mientras el objeto maestro tenga roll-up summary fields que dependan de esa relación: primero hay que borrarlos. Que el campo tenga valor en todos los registros o que sea obligatorio no impide el cambio, y un lookup no necesita ningún junction object.

questions.stem: When a sales rep clicks a button on an opportunity, a simple discount calculator screen should be launched. Which automation tool should a Platform Administrator use to build this discount calculator screen?

options.text: Flow Builder
Platform Event
Batch Apex
OmniStudio

questions.explanationEs: Un screen flow de Flow Builder puede mostrar pantallas, pedir datos y hacer cálculos, y se lanza desde un botón o una quick action de la oportunidad. Platform Events y Batch Apex trabajan en segundo plano, sin interfaz, y OmniStudio es excesivo para una calculadora sencilla.

questions.stem: The CTO of AW Computing has defined a new policy for cases to improve customer satisfaction. All cases submitted with a Case Reason of Installation must be acknowledged immediately through email and assigned to the appropriate agents. Any cases that are still in the New status after 4 hours must be escalated to support management. A Platform Administrator has implemented auto-response rules. Which additional case management tool is necessary to meet this requirement?

options.text: Support Processes
Escalation Rules
Formulas
Entitlements

questions.explanationEs: Las auto-response rules ya cubren el acuse de recibo. Lo que falta, escalar los casos que siguen en New a las 4 horas, lo hacen las escalation rules: revisan los casos abiertos y, cuando se cumple el plazo, los reasignan o avisan a quien se indique. Los support processes solo definen los valores de Status, y los entitlements miden niveles de servicio con milestones, algo más complejo de lo que se pide.

questions.stem: The marketing director at Northern Trail Outfitters has requested that the Budget field be populated in order for the Lead Status field to be marked as qualified. Which tool should a Platform Administrator use to fulfill this request?

options.text: Lead Conversion
Require Field
Workflow Rule
Validation Rule

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule puede impedir guardar el lead cuando Lead Status es Qualified y Budget está vacío (con ISPICKVAL e ISBLANK, por ejemplo). Hacer el campo obligatorio lo exigiría siempre, no solo al calificar el lead, y ni la conversión de leads ni un workflow impiden guardar.

questions.stem: A Platform Administrator needs to import 65,000 new records into a custom object. Which tool should the administrator use?

options.text: Data Loader
Data Import Wizard
Rest API
Schema Builder

questions.explanationEs: Data Import Wizard admite hasta 50.000 registros por importación, así que para 65.000 hace falta Data Loader, que llega a 5 millones y funciona con cualquier objeto. La REST API obligaría a programar, y Schema Builder solo sirve para ver y editar el modelo de datos.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar is noticing a decrease in deals with a cross-sell opportunity type and want to share all cross-sell opportunities with a team of subject matter experts in their organization. The company has different roles, and the organization-wide default for Opportunity is set to Private. How should the administrator accomplish this?

options.text: Create a new role for the subject matter experts and give them access to the records with an owner based sharing rule.
Enable territory management, assign the subject matter experts to the same territory, and give them access to the records with manual sharing.
Change the organization-wide default for Opportunity from Private to Public Read/Write to open up access for the subject matter experts.
Add the subject matter experts to a public group and give them access to the records with a criteria-based sharing.

questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de Opportunity en Private, la forma de abrir solo las oportunidades de cross-sell a un grupo concreto es una criteria-based sharing rule (Type = Cross-sell) que las comparta con un public group donde estén los expertos. Una owner-based sharing rule comparte según el propietario, no según el tipo; Territory Management y la compartición manual no escalan, y pasar el OWD a Public Read/Write abriría todas las oportunidades a todo el mundo.

questions.stem: An administrator at Cloud Kicks is building a flow that needs to search for records that meet certain conditions and store values from those records in variables for use later in the flow. What flow element should the administrator add?

options.text: Create Records
Get Records
Update Records
Assignment

questions.explanationEs: El elemento Get Records busca los registros que cumplen unas condiciones y guarda sus campos en variables para usarlos después en el flow. Create Records y Update Records crean o modifican registros, y Assignment solo da valor a variables, sin consultar la base de datos.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar offers amazing experiences for all of its employees. The employee engagement committee wants to post updates while restricting other employees from posting. What should the administrator create to meet this request?

options.text: Chatter Recommendations
Chatter Stream
Chatter Broadcast Group
Chatter Unlisted Group

questions.explanationEs: En un Chatter broadcast group solo publican los propietarios y managers del grupo; el resto de miembros lee y comenta. Encaja con un comité que quiere publicar novedades sin que los demás publiquen. Un unlisted group solo controla quién ve el grupo, un Chatter stream reúne varios feeds para leerlos y las recomendaciones sugieren contenido.

questions.stem: An administrator has assigned a permission set group with the multi-factor authentication for User Interface Logins permission and the multi-factor authentication for API Logins permission to a group of users. Which two prompts will happen when one of the users attempts to log in to Data Loader for the first time?

options.text: Users need to download and install an authenticator app on their mobile device.
Users need to enter a verification code from email or SMS, whichever has higher priority.
Users need to get a security token from a trusted network using Reset My Security Token.
Users need to connect an authenticator app to their Salesforce account.

questions.explanationEs: Con el permiso Multi-Factor Authentication for API Logins, al entrar en Data Loader el usuario introduce un código de una app autenticadora en lugar del security token. Por eso, la primera vez tendrá que descargar e instalar la app en el móvil y conectarla a su cuenta de Salesforce. Los códigos por email o SMS no sirven aquí, y el security token es justo lo que el código sustituye.

questions.stem: Support reps at Cloud Kicks (CK) are reporting that when they try to close a case, the Closed option in the Case Status picklist is missing. CK has asked the administrator to find a solution. Why are the support reps unable to see the Closed option in the specified picklist?

options.text: The Support Process being used omits Closed as a status choice.
The Close Case page layout must be used to close a case.
The Show Closed Statuses in Case Status Field checkbox is set to the default.
The Case record type is missing Closed as a picklist value.

questions.reviewNote: Success4Exam culpa al support process, pero su explicación se equivoca con el ajuste «Show Closed Statuses in Case Status Field» de Support Settings: es el que hace que los estados cerrados aparezcan en el campo Status, y viene desactivado por defecto. Las dos causas son posibles y ninguna fuente oficial lo aclara.
questions.explanationEs: El support process asignado al record type de Case decide qué valores de Status se ofrecen; si omite Closed, los agentes no pueden elegirlo. Además, Salesforce no muestra los estados cerrados en el campo Status hasta que se activa «Show Closed Statuses in Case Status Field» en Support Settings; mientras tanto, los casos se cierran con la acción Close Case.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has a customer success agent going on leave and needs to change ownership on multiple cases. Which two users are able to fulfill this request?

options.text: A user with Read permission on the account.
A user with the Manage Cases permission.
A user with a manager role above the agent.
A user with the System Administrator profile.

questions.explanationEs: Para reasignar en bloque los casos de otro agente hace falta un permiso que permita gestionar casos ajenos, como Manage Cases, o el perfil de System Administrator, que lo incluye todo.
