Poder leer la cuenta no da ningún permiso sobre sus casos, y estar por encima en la jerarquía de roles da acceso a registros, no permisos de administración de casos.

questions.stem: AW Computing would like to improve its Case Lightning record page by including: A filtered component to display a message in bold font when a Case is saved as a critical record type. A quick way to update the Account status from the Case layout. Which two components should an administrator use to satisfy these requests?

options.text: Related record
Record detail
Rich text
Related list

questions.explanationEs: El componente Rich Text muestra un texto con formato, como la negrita, y con un filtro de visibilidad solo aparece cuando el caso tiene el record type crítico. El componente Related Record muestra y permite editar un registro relacionado, como la cuenta del caso, sin salir de la página. Record Detail muestra los campos del propio caso, y una related list enumera registros hijos.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks' executives have noticed the Opportunity Expected Revenue field displays incorrect values. How should the administrator correct this?

options.text: Modify the closed won value associated with the stage.
Update the expected revenue associated with the stage.
Change the probability associated with the stage.
Adjust the forecast category associated with the stage.

questions.explanationEs: Expected Revenue se calcula como Amount × Probability, y la probabilidad por defecto la fija cada etapa (stage) de la oportunidad. Si los valores salen mal, hay que revisar la probabilidad asociada a cada etapa. No existe un valor de Expected Revenue por etapa, y la forecast category solo afecta a las previsiones.

questions.stem: An administrator at Universal Containers has been asked to prevent some users from accessing Salesforce from outside of their network. What are two considerations for this configuration?

options.text: Assign single sign-on to a permission set to allow users to log in when outside the network.
Restrict U2F Security Keys on the user's profile to enforce login hours.
Enforce Login IP Ranges on Every Request on the profile must be selected to enforce IP restrictions.
IP address restrictions are set on the profile for the org.

questions.explanationEs: Las restricciones de IP se definen en Login IP Ranges del perfil: fuera de esos rangos el usuario no puede iniciar sesión. Para que se comprueben en cada petición y no solo al entrar, hay que activar Enforce Login IP Ranges on Every Request, que está en Session Settings. El single sign-on no se salta las restricciones de IP, y las llaves U2F son un método de verificación de identidad, no controlan la red ni el horario.

questions.stem: An administrator installed a managed package that contains a permission set group. The permission set group that was installed includes Delete access on several objects, and the administrator needs to prevent users in the permission set group from being able to delete records. What should the administrator do to control Delete access?

options.text: Edit the profile for the users to remove Delete access from the objects.
Use a muting permission set with a permission set group to mute selected permissions.
Create a new role that prevents Delete permissions from rolling up to the users.
Create a new permission set that has Delete access deselected for the objects.

questions.explanationEs: Un muting permission set dentro del permission set group desactiva permisos concretos, como Delete en esos objetos, sin tocar los permission sets del paquete gestionado. Los permisos se suman: un permission set nuevo sin Delete no quita lo que concede el grupo, y quitarlo del perfil tampoco sirve. Los roles controlan el acceso a registros, no los permisos sobre objetos.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to calculate how much revenue has been generated for each of its marketing campaigns. How should an administrator deliver this information?

options.text: Design a standard Campaign report and add the Value Won Opportunities in Campaign field.
Perform periodic data jobs to update campaign records.
Create a roll-up summary field on Opportunity to Campaign.
Add a Total Value field on Campaign and use a workflow rule to update the value when an opportunity is won.

questions.explanationEs: Las campañas calculan solas estadísticas como Value Won Opportunities in Campaign, que suma el importe de las oportunidades ganadas asociadas a cada campaña, así que basta un informe estándar de campañas con ese campo. Opportunity no es detalle de Campaign en un master-detail, por lo que no admite un roll-up summary, y los procesos manuales o con workflow sobran.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to use Contact Hierarchy in its org to display Contact association. What should the administrator take into consideration regarding the Contact Hierarchy?

options.text: Sharing settings are ignored by contacts displayed in the Contact Hierarchy.
Contact Hierarchy is limited to only display 3,000 contacts at one time.
Contacts displayed in the Contact Hierarchy are limited to record-level access by user.
Customizing hierarchy columns changes the Recently Viewed Contacts list view.

questions.explanationEs: La Contact Hierarchy muestra cómo se relacionan los contactos de una cuenta a través del campo Reports To, y respeta el acceso a registros: cada usuario solo ve en ella los contactos que puede ver. No ignora el sharing, y personalizar sus columnas no cambia la list view de contactos vistos recientemente.

questions.stem: The service manager at Ursa Major Solar wants to let customers know that they have received their cases via email and their website. Medium-priority and high-priority cases should receive different email notifications than low-priority cases. The administrator has created three email templates for this purpose. How should an administrator configure this requirement?

options.text: Create one auto-response rule. Configure three rule entry criteria and set a filter for case priority. Select the appropriate email template for each rule entry.
Include three assignment rules that fire when cases are created. Add a filter for case priority. Select the appropriate email template for each rule.
Add three auto-response rules. Configure one rule entry criteria for each rule and set a filter for case priority. Select the appropriate email template for each rule entry.
Configure one workflow rule that fires when cases are created. Add a filter for case priority. Select the appropriate email template for the rule.

questions.explanationEs: Solo puede haber una auto-response rule activa por objeto, pero puede tener varias rule entries que se evalúan en orden. Con tres entradas filtradas por la prioridad del caso, cada una con su plantilla, cada cliente recibe el email que le toca. Las assignment rules asignan el caso y no envían acuses de recibo, y un único workflow con un filtro no distingue tres plantillas.

questions.stem: Users have noticed that when they click on a report in a dashboard to view the report details, the values in the report are different from the values displayed on the dashboard. What are the two reasons this is likely to occur?

options.text: The current user does not have access to the report folder.
The dashboard needs to be refreshed.
The report needs to be refreshed.
The running dashboard user and viewer have different permissions.

questions.explanationEs: Un dashboard muestra los datos de su último refresco y con la visibilidad de su running user, mientras que el informe se ejecuta al abrirlo y con la visibilidad de quien lo mira. Si el dashboard lleva tiempo sin refrescarse, o si el running user ve otros registros que el usuario, los números no coinciden. Sin acceso a la carpeta no podría abrir el informe, y el informe ya muestra los datos del momento.

questions.stem: An administrator wants to create a form in Salesforce for users to fill out when they lose a client. Which automation tool supports creating a wizard to accomplish this goal?

options.text: Process Builder
Flow Builder
Approval Process
Outbound Message

questions.explanationEs: Un screen flow de Flow Builder funciona como un asistente: varias pantallas con campos y decisiones que guían al usuario y guardan los datos. Process Builder no tiene interfaz (y está retirado), un approval process gestiona aprobaciones y un outbound message envía datos a otro sistema.

questions.stem: An administrator wants to trigger a follow-up task for the opportunity owner when they close an opportunity as won, and another task after 60 days to check in with the customer. Which automation tool should the administrator use?

options.text: Flow Builder
Assignment Rule
Field Update
Outbound Message

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow en Opportunity puede crear la tarea de seguimiento en cuanto la oportunidad se gana y, con un scheduled path, otra tarea 60 días después. Las assignment rules asignan propietarios, una field update solo cambia un campo y un outbound message envía datos fuera de Salesforce.

questions.stem: The administrator at Cloud Kicks created a new field for tracking returns on their new cloud shoe. A user has submitted a case to the administrator indicating that the new field is unavailable. Which two steps should an administrator do to troubleshoot this issue?

options.text: Run the setup audit trail for the organization.
Update the organization-wide defaults for the object.
Review the field-level security of the field for the user profile.
Ensure that the page layout for the user's profile has been updated.

questions.explanationEs: Si un usuario no ve un campo nuevo, lo primero es revisar su field-level security en el perfil del usuario y comprobar que el campo está en el page layout que tiene asignado. Setup Audit Trail registra cambios de configuración y los OWD controlan el acceso a registros; ninguno decide si un campo se ve.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters has a custom quick action on Account that creates a new Case. How should an administrator make the quick action available on the Salesforce mobile app?

options.text: Add the Salesforce Mobile and Lightning Experience action to the page layout.
Create a custom Lightning App with the action.
Include the action in the Salesforce Mobile Navigation menu.
Modify compact Case page layout to include the action.

questions.explanationEs: Las quick actions aparecen en la app móvil y en Lightning Experience cuando se añaden a la sección Salesforce Mobile and Lightning Experience Actions del page layout. El menú de navegación del móvil muestra objetos y pestañas, no acciones, y el compact layout decide qué campos salen en el panel de resumen.

questions.stem: Universal Containers has a Contact Lightning record page with a component that shows LinkedIn data. The sales team would like to only show this component to those users who have the Sales User profile when they are on their mobile phones. Which two solutions should the administrator use to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Filter the component visibility with User> Profile > Name = Sales User.
Filter the component visibility with User> Role > Name = Sales User.
Filter the component visibility with View = Mobile/Tablet.
Filter the component visibility with Form Factor = Phone.

questions.explanationEs: Los filtros de visibilidad de un componente en Lightning App Builder pueden combinar una condición sobre el usuario (User > Profile > Name = Sales User) y otra sobre el dispositivo (Form Factor = Phone). Filtrar por rol no garantiza el perfil, y no existe un filtro «View = Mobile/Tablet»: el tipo de dispositivo se filtra con Form Factor.

questions.stem: Which two objects are customizable in the Stage Setup Flow?

options.text: Leads
Campaigns
Campaign Members
Opportunities

questions.explanationEs: El flujo guiado de configuración de etapas (Stage Setup Flow) sirve para definir las fases del proceso de venta: los estados de Lead y las etapas de Opportunity. Campaign y Campaign Member tienen sus propios estados, pero no forman parte de ese proceso.

questions.stem: Which tool should an administrator use to identify and fix potential session vulnerabilities?

options.text: Setup Audit Trail
Field History Tracking
Organization-Wide Defaults
Health Check

questions.explanationEs: Health Check compara la configuración de seguridad del org, incluida la de sesión, con la línea base de Salesforce, puntúa los riesgos y permite corregirlos con Fix Risks. Setup Audit Trail registra cambios de configuración, Field History Tracking registra cambios de valores y los OWD controlan el acceso a registros; ninguno detecta vulnerabilidades.

questions.stem: AW Computing needs to capture a loss reason in a rich text field when an opportunity is closed lost. How should an administrator configure this requirement?

options.text: Select the required Checkbox next to the Loss Reason field on the page layout.
Create a validation rule to display an error if stage is closed lost and Loss Reason is blank.
Configure a workflow rule to display an error if Loss Reason is blank.
Check the required checkbox on the Loss Reason field in Object Manager.

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule que dé error cuando Stage es Closed Lost y Loss Reason está vacío obliga a rellenar el motivo solo cuando hace falta. Marcar el campo como obligatorio en el page layout o en Object Manager lo exigiría en todas las oportunidades, y un workflow no puede mostrar errores ni impedir el guardado.

questions.stem: The standard Lead Rating field has picklist values of Hot, Warm, and Cold. A list of new leads imported without errors even though several records had the value of Unrated in the Rating field. How were these records added without error?

options.text: A global picklist value set was used to populate the picklist.
The Restricted picklist checkbox was unchecked.
The Add to All Record Types checkbox was selected.
Field level security was set to Visible for all profiles.

questions.explanationEs: Si el picklist no está restringido (la casilla «Restrict picklist to the values defined in the value set» está desmarcada), la API y las importaciones aceptan valores que no están en la lista, como Unrated. Un global value set o añadir el valor a todos los record types no cambian eso, y la field-level security solo decide quién ve o edita el campo.

questions.stem: The administrator at Cloud Kicks updated the custom object Event to include a lookup field to the primary contact for the event. When running an event report, they want to reference fields from the associated contact record. What should the administrator do to pull contact fields into the custom report?

options.text: Edit the custom Event report type and add fields related via lookup.
Use a dashboard with filters to show Event and contact data as requested.
Configure formula fields on Event to populate contact information.
Create a new report type with Event as the primary object and Contact as a related object.

questions.explanationEs: En el layout de un custom report type, «Add fields related via lookup» añade campos de los registros relacionados por un lookup: así el informe de Event muestra campos del contacto principal sin crear otro report type. Contact es el padre de ese lookup, así que no se puede añadir como objeto relacionado (hijo) del report type, y los formula fields o un dashboard no lo resuelven tan bien.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks generates leads for its different product categories (shoes, apparel, and accessories) through many different sources. While some lead sources are used for all three categories, other lead sources are specific to a single category. The VP of marketing requests that only the proper lead sources be displayed based on the product category chosen. How should the administrator configure Salesforce to meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a page layout for each category and filter the Lead Source field based on category.
Create business processes and record types for each of the three product categories.
Create a single lead process, then create record types for each product category.
Create a dependency between the Product Category field and Lead Source field.

questions.explanationEs: Un dependent picklist muestra en Lead Source solo los valores asociados a la Product Category elegida, que actúa como campo controlador, y un mismo origen puede asociarse a varias categorías. Los page layouts no filtran valores de picklist, los Lead Processes solo definen los valores de Lead Status y los record types obligarían a elegir uno antes de rellenar el lead.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters uses web-to-case to convert support requests submitted through its website into cases. The support team wants to automatically send an email containing password reset instructions to customers when the case subject contains the words "forgot" and "password." What two options should the administrator configure to meet this requirement?

options.text: Auto-response rule
Email-to-case
Password reset template
Email template

questions.explanationEs: Una case auto-response rule puede enviar un email automático a quien abre el caso por web-to-case cuando se cumple un criterio, como que el asunto contenga forgot y password. El texto con las instrucciones va en una email template. Email-to-Case crea casos a partir de emails, y la plantilla de restablecimiento de contraseña de Salesforce es para los usuarios del org, no para los clientes.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to track shoe designs by product because there can be multiple designs for one product across various stages. They need to know how many designs have been created for a given product on the product record. Which two steps should the administrator configure to meet this requirement?

options.text: Configure a custom lookup field for shoe designs on the Product object.
Use the standard object for designs.
Add a custom master-detail field for shoe designs on the Design object.
Create a custom object for shoe designs.

questions.explanationEs: Hace falta un objeto personalizado para los diseños y, en él, un campo master-detail hacia Product: así cada producto puede tener muchos diseños y un roll-up summary field en Product puede contarlos. Un lookup no permite roll-up summary fields, y no existe ningún objeto estándar para diseños.

questions.stem: The business development team at Cloud Kicks thinks the Account creation process has too many fields to fill out and the page feels cluttered. They have requested the administrator to simplify the process. Which automation tool should an administrator use?

options.text: Flow Builder
Workflow Rule
Approval Process
Validation Rule

questions.explanationEs: Un screen flow puede guiar la creación de cuentas pidiendo solo los campos imprescindibles, en una o varias pantallas, en lugar de un formulario largo. Las workflow rules, los approval processes y las validation rules actúan al guardar o después, pero no cambian lo que el usuario ve al crear el registro.

questions.stem: A team of support users at Cloud Kicks is helping inside sales reps make follow-up calls to prospects that filled out an interest form online. The team currently does not have access to the Lead object. How should an administrator provide proper access?

options.text: Configure permission sets
Set up Manual sharing
Create a new profile
Assign a new role

questions.explanationEs: Si el perfil no da acceso al objeto Lead, hay que añadir permisos de objeto, y para un grupo concreto lo más limpio es un permission set con Read y Edit sobre Lead asignado a esos usuarios. Un perfil nuevo también funcionaría, pero da más trabajo y es menos flexible. El manual sharing y los roles dan acceso a registros, no al objeto.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters has hired interns to enter Leads into Salesforce and has requested a way to identify these new records from existing Leads. What approach should an administrator take to meet this requirement?

options.text: Set up Web-to-Lead for the interns' use.
Update the active Lead Assignment Rules.
Define a record type and assign it to the interns.
Create a separate Lead Lightning App.

questions.explanationEs: Un record type propio para los leads de los becarios, asignado a su perfil o a un permission set, marca cada lead nuevo para distinguirlo de los existentes, y además permite darles su propio page layout y sus valores de picklist. Web-to-Lead sirve para formularios web, las assignment rules reparten la propiedad y una app aparte no marca los registros.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks users are seeing error messages when they use one of their screen flows. The error messages are confusing but could be resolved if the users entered more information on the account before starting the flow. How should the administrator address this issue?

options.text: Uncheck the End User Flow Errors box in Setup.
Remove validation rules so that the users are able to proceed without complete records.
Use a fault connector and display a screen with text explaining what went wrong and how to correct it.
Create a permission set to allow users to bypass the error.

questions.explanationEs: Un fault connector lleva el flow por otro camino cuando falla un elemento, y ahí una pantalla puede explicar qué ha pasado y qué datos de la cuenta hay que completar. Ocultar los errores, quitar validation rules o dar permisos para saltárselas no resuelve el problema y empeora la calidad de los datos.

questions.stem: The administrator at Cloud Kicks writes an assignment rule to send all cases created via email or the web to the Automated Cases Queue. Any manually created cases should be owned by the agent creating them; however, the manually created cases now show the administrator as the owner. What will the administrator find when troubleshooting this issue?

options.text: The Owner field is missing on the webform and email template.
The Assignment Rule checkbox is selected by default.
Another assignment rule is giving ownership to the administrator.
An escalation rule is changing the case owner on case creation.

questions.explanationEs: En el page layout de Case se puede dejar marcada por defecto la casilla «Assign using active assignment rule». Entonces también los casos creados a mano pasan por las assignment rules, y los que no cumplen ninguna entrada van al propietario por defecto de Support Settings, aquí el administrador. Las escalation rules actúan pasado un tiempo, no al crear el caso.

questions.stem: An administrator supporting a global team of Salesforce users has been asked to configure company settings. Which two options should the administrator configure?

options.text: Default Language
Currency Locale
Login Hours
Password Policy

questions.explanationEs: En Company Information se definen datos de toda la organización, como el idioma por defecto (Default Language), el locale y el Currency Locale. Las login hours y las password policies no son ajustes de empresa: las primeras van en el perfil y las segundas en la seguridad del org.

questions.stem: An administrator at Cloud Kicks wants to deactivate a user who has left the company. What are two reasons that would prevent a user from being deactivated?

options.text: The user is the highest role in the role hierarchy.
The user is the sole recipient of a workflow email alert.
The user is part of a territory hierarchy.
The user is in a custom hierarchy field.

questions.explanationEs: Salesforce no deja desactivar a un usuario que sea el único destinatario de una email alert o que figure en un campo de jerarquía personalizado, como un Manager: antes hay que sustituirlo. Ser el rol más alto de la jerarquía o pertenecer a una jerarquía de territorios no bloquea la desactivación. Mientras se resuelve, se puede congelar (freeze) al usuario para que no entre.

questions.stem: The administrator at Ursa Major Solar has created a custom report type and built a report for the sales operations team. However, none of the users are able to access the report. Which two options could cause this issue?

options.text: The custom report type is in development.
The user's profile is missing View access.
The org has reached its limit for custom report types.
The report is saved in a private folder.

questions.explanationEs: Mientras un custom report type está en In Development, solo los usuarios con el permiso Manage Custom Report Types ven los informes que lo usan; hay que pasarlo a Deployed. Y si el informe está en una carpeta privada, solo lo ve su propietario. El límite de report types impediría crear más, no usar los que ya existen.

questions.stem: The administrator has created new users for ten new employees at Northern Trail Outfitters. Why are these users unable to view the account tab in the Salesforce org?

options.text: Organization-wide defaults are set to private.
Users' profile requires permission to the Account object.
Users' profile requires a sharing rule for Accounts.
Users' roles are low on the role hierarchy.

questions.explanationEs: Para ver la pestaña de Account, el perfil o un permission set tienen que dar al menos Read sobre el objeto. El OWD, las sharing rules y la jerarquía de roles deciden qué registros se ven, pero no dan acceso al objeto si el perfil no lo tiene.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty regularly holds open houses for the selling of both houses and condominiums. For condominium open houses, there are a few extra steps that need to be taken. Agents need to be able to submit requests and receive approvals from the homeowners' association. How can the administrator ensure these extra steps only appear when creating open house records for condominiums?

options.text: Create one page layout. Use record types to ensure the proper status picklist values display.
Create two page layouts. Use processes and record types to display the appropriate picklist values.
Create one page layout. Use business processes to ensure the proper status picklist values display.
Create two page layouts, one with a House Status field and the other with a Condominium Status field.

questions.explanationEs: Con dos record types (casa y condominio), cada uno con su page layout y sus valores de picklist, los pasos extra solo aparecen en las visitas de condominio, y un approval process gestiona las aprobaciones de la comunidad de propietarios. Un único page layout no muestra cosas distintas según el tipo, y dos layouts sin record types no se asignan solos al registro adecuado.

questions.stem: AW Computing (AWC) occasionally works with independent contractors, who the company stores as Contacts in Salesforce. Contractors often change agencies, and AWC wants to maintain the historical accuracy of the record. What should AWC use to track Contacts?

options.text: Enable Contacts to multiple Accounts.
Create a junction object to track many-to-many relationship.
Create a new Contact record for each agency.
Use a partner community to track the Contacts.

questions.explanationEs: Con Contacts to Multiple Accounts, un contacto se relaciona con varias cuentas (sus agencias) además de su cuenta principal, y al cambiar de agencia se conserva el historial sin duplicar el contacto. Crear un contacto por agencia rompe ese historial, un junction object personalizado reinventa algo que Salesforce ya trae y una partner community sirve para dar acceso a usuarios externos.

questions.stem: An administrator at Northern Trail Outfitters is creating a validation rule. Which two functions should the administrator use when creating a validation rule?

options.text: Error condition formula
Error message location
Rule active date
Formula return type

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule se define con una error condition formula, que devuelve verdadero cuando los datos no son válidos, y con un mensaje de error y su ubicación: arriba de la página o junto a un campo. No tiene fecha de activación (solo se activa o se desactiva), y la fórmula siempre devuelve un booleano, así que su tipo no se elige.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to update a screen flow so that if the checkbox field High Value Customer is set to true, the first screen is skipped and the user is directed to the second screen. How should the administrator configure the decision element?

options.text: Use the contains operator and (!$GlobalConstant.False) as the value.
Use the equals operator and "High Value Customer" as the value.
Use the equals operator and (!$GlobalConstant.True) as the value.
Use the contains operator and "High Value Customer" as the value.

questions.explanationEs: Una casilla de verificación es un valor booleano, así que la condición del decision element debe ser High Value Customer Equals {!$GlobalConstant.True}; si se cumple, el flow salta a la segunda pantalla. El operador Contains es para texto, y comparar con el nombre del campo escrito como texto no tiene sentido.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has the organization-wide sharing default set to private on the Shoe object. The sales manager should be able to view a report containing shoe records for all of the sales reps on their team. Which three items should the administrator configure to provide appropriate access to the report?

options.text: Role Hierarchy
Report Subscription
Custom Report Type
Field-Level Security
Folder Access

questions.explanationEs: Con el OWD de Shoe en Private, el manager ve los registros de su equipo gracias a la jerarquía de roles; además necesita field-level security sobre los campos del informe y acceso a la carpeta donde está guardado. Una suscripción solo envía el informe, y el report type define qué objetos y campos se pueden usar, pero no da acceso a nada.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) has deployed My Domain. The Chief Marketing Officer wants to make sure that all of the Salesforce users log in using the branded login URL. There needs to be a grace period for the user's bookmarks to be updated. How should the administrator configure the policies in the My Domain settings?

options.text: Set the login policy to require login from https://nto.my.salesforce.com
Set the Redirect policy to Do Not redirect.
Set the login policy to prevent login from https://login.salesforce.com
Set the redirect policy to Redirect with a warning to the same page within the domain.

questions.explanationEs: La redirect policy «Redirect with a warning to the same page within the domain» lleva a los usuarios a la URL de My Domain y les avisa de que actualicen sus marcadores, así que da un periodo de transición. Sin redirección nadie llega a la URL de marca, y bloquear el login desde login.salesforce.com cortaría el acceso de golpe, sin periodo de gracia.

questions.stem: What should an administrator use as an identifier when importing and updating records from a separate financial system?

options.text: Record ID
Rich Text field
External ID
Auto-Number field

questions.explanationEs: Un campo marcado como External ID guarda el identificador del registro en el sistema financiero, y Data Loader o Data Import Wizard lo usan para casar los registros al actualizar o al hacer upsert. El Record ID de Salesforce no existe en el sistema externo, un auto-number lo genera Salesforce y un rich text no sirve como identificador.

questions.stem: The Support team at Ursa Major Solar occasionally views shipments from an application external to Salesforce. What is the best way to configure the UI to allow for this functionality?

options.text: Use external objects and add a custom tab to the Support App for support agents.
Filter by a single shipment record type in the list view.
Add the Manage List Views permission for support users.
Split views are only available on standard objects.

questions.explanationEs: Los external objects de Salesforce Connect muestran datos que viven en otro sistema sin copiarlos a Salesforce, y con una pestaña personalizada en la Support App los agentes los consultan como cualquier otro objeto. Las list views, los record types y el permiso Manage List Views solo trabajan con datos que ya están en Salesforce.

questions.stem: The marketing team wants a new picklist value added to the Campaign Member Status field for the upsell promotional campaign. Which two solutions should the administrator use to modify the picklist field values?

options.text: Modify the picklist value on the Campaign Member Statuses related list.
Mass modify the Campaign Member Statuses related list.
Add the Campaign Member Statuses related list to the Page Layout.
Edit the picklist values for the Campaign Status in Object Manager.

questions.explanationEs: Los estados de miembro de campaña no se editan en Object Manager: se definen en cada campaña, en la related list Campaign Member Statuses. Para poder modificarlos, esa related list tiene que estar en el page layout de Campaign. Campaign Status es otro campo: el estado de la propia campaña.

questions.stem: At Universal Containers, users would like to be able to share Salesforce records with other members of their team, while collaborating around general topics as well. Which are two considerations for enabling this functionality?

options.text: An administrator needs to create a group to enable record sharing.
Object layouts should be configured to include the groups related list.
The Add Record action must be configured in the group publisher.
Collaboration groups are created automatically for every department.

questions.explanationEs: Para compartir registros en grupos de Chatter, el page layout del objeto debe tener la related list Groups y el publisher de los grupos debe incluir la acción Add Record. Así los miembros añaden registros al grupo y colaboran sobre ellos junto a los temas generales. Los usuarios pueden crear sus propios grupos, y Salesforce no crea grupos por departamento.

questions.stem: Universal Containers created a new job posting on the first of the month. It triggered a process scheduled action that will send a Chatter post to the department VP in 30 days if the position is still open and the status is not equal to Interviewing. On the 10th of the month, an applicant interviews, and the job posting status is updated to Interviewing. What will happen to the Chatter post in this situation?

options.text: The pending Chatter post will be paused.
The pending Chatter post will be sent on the 10th of the month.
The pending Chatter post will be sent in 30 days.
The pending Chatter post will be canceled.

questions.reviewNote: Process Builder está retirado y ya no se usa para automatizaciones nuevas. Hoy se haría con un scheduled path de un record-triggered flow que se ejecute solo cuando el registro pasa a cumplir la condición: si deja de cumplirla antes de la fecha, la acción programada también se cancela.
questions.explanationEs: Una acción programada de Process Builder se quita de la cola si, antes de ejecutarse, el registro deja de cumplir los criterios del proceso. Al pasar el estado a Interviewing el día 10, el post de Chatter pendiente se cancela: no se pausa ni se envía más tarde.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks is working on a better way to track its product shipments utilizing Salesforce. Which field type should an administrator use to capture coordinates?

options.text: Geofence
Custom address
External lookup
Geolocation

questions.explanationEs: Un campo Geolocation guarda la latitud y la longitud, así que sirve para registrar las coordenadas de un envío. Un campo de dirección guarda la dirección postal, un external lookup relaciona con un external object y una geofence es un área geográfica, no un tipo de campo.

questions.stem: The administrator at Northern Trail Outfitters has been using a spreadsheet to track assigned licenses and permission sets. What feature can be used to track this in Salesforce?

options.text: Lightning Usage App
Permission Set Groups
User Report
Login History

questions.explanationEs: Un informe de usuarios, con un custom report type que incluya las asignaciones de permission sets si hace falta, muestra quién tiene cada licencia, perfil y permission set, y está siempre al día, sin mantener una hoja de cálculo. La Lightning Usage App mide la adopción, Login History registra los accesos y los permission set groups agrupan permisos, pero no sirven para hacer este seguimiento.

questions.stem: The administrator at AW Computing wants Account details, related lists, and Chatter feeds to each appear on separate tabs when viewing an Account. Which type of page should the administrator create?

options.text: Lightning home page
Lightning app page
Lightning page component
Lightning record page

questions.explanationEs: Una Lightning record page puede llevar un componente Tabs con una pestaña para los detalles, otra para las related lists y otra para el feed de Chatter. Las home pages y las app pages no están ligadas a un registro, y un componente es una pieza de una página, no un tipo de página.

questions.stem: Which setting on a profile makes a tab hidden in the App Launcher and in every app, but still allows a user to view records that would normally be found under this tab?

options.text: Org-wide Defaults
Object Permissions
App Permissions
Tab Settings

questions.explanationEs: En los Tab Settings del perfil, una pestaña en Tab Hidden desaparece del App Launcher y de todas las apps, pero si el perfil tiene permisos sobre el objeto, el usuario sigue viendo sus registros desde búsquedas, related lists o enlaces. Los permisos de objeto controlan el acceso a los datos, no la visibilidad de la pestaña, y los OWD tampoco tienen que ver con ella.

questions.stem: What is the order of execution when a Case record is saved?

options.text: Assignment rules, Auto-response rules, Workflow rules, Escalation rules
Validation rules, Escalation rules, Workflow rules, Auto-response rules
Assignment rules, Validation rules, Workflow rules, Escalation rules
Validation rules, Assignment rules, Escalation rules, Auto-response rules

questions.explanationEs: Al guardar un caso, Salesforce ejecuta primero las validation rules y, con el registro ya guardado, las assignment rules, las auto-response rules, las workflow rules y, al final, las escalation rules. Por eso el orden es asignación, respuesta automática, workflow y escalado; las validaciones van antes que todo eso.

questions.stem: Which three items are available in the mobile navigation menu?

options.text: Utility Bar
Dashboards
Lightning Home Page
Chatter

questions.explanationEs: El menú de navegación de la app móvil (Salesforce Navigation, en Setup) puede incluir elementos como Chatter, Dashboards o páginas de Lightning, entre ellas la home. La utility bar es una función de Lightning Experience en escritorio y no existe en la app móvil.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to encourage employees to choose secure and appropriate passwords for their Salesforce accounts. Which three password policies should an administrator configure?

options.text: Prohibited password values
Number of days until expiration
Maximum invalid login attempts
Require use of Password Manager App
Password complexity requirements

questions.reviewNote: Hasta donde sé, Password Policies no tiene ningún ajuste llamado «Prohibited password values»; sí tiene «Maximum invalid login attempts». Puede que la clave correcta sea caducidad, complejidad y máximo de intentos fallidos, aunque este último protege contra ataques más que ayudar a elegir buenas contraseñas.
questions.explanationEs: La caducidad y los requisitos de complejidad son password policies que obligan a renovar la contraseña y a que sea robusta; según la fuente, prohibir ciertos valores (contraseñas débiles o habituales) completa el trío. El máximo de intentos fallidos bloquea la cuenta tras varios errores, así que protege contra ataques pero no ayuda a elegir la contraseña. Salesforce no exige ninguna app de gestión de contraseñas.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty needs to use consistent picklist values in the Category field on Accounts and Cases, with values respective to record types. Which two features should the administrator use to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Custom picklist
Global picklist
Dependent picklist
Multi-select picklist

questions.reviewNote: Success4Exam marca el dependent picklist, pero aquí los valores no dependen de otro campo, sino del record type. El Debrief da esta otra clave: un campo picklist personalizado en Account y otro en Case que comparten un global value set.
questions.explanationEs: Un global value set (global picklist) guarda la lista de valores una sola vez, y cada objeto la usa en su propio campo picklist personalizado Category, así que Account y Case comparten siempre los mismos valores. Después, en cada record type se eligen los valores que se muestran. Un dependent picklist filtra según otro campo, no según el record type, y un multi-select picklist solo permite marcar varios valores.

questions.stem: What are three settings an administrator should configure to make it easy for approvers to respond to approval requests?

options.text: Enable the organization's email approval response setting.
Update the organization's Chatter settings to allow approvals.
Specify initial submission actions within the approval process.
Add the Items to Approve component to the approvers' home page.
Create a flow to automatically approve all records.

questions.explanationEs: Para que los aprobadores respondan con facilidad se puede activar la respuesta por email (Enable Email Approval Response), permitir las aprobaciones en Chatter (Allow Approvals, en Chatter Settings) y añadir el componente Items to Approve a su home page. Las initial submission actions se ejecutan al enviar el registro y no ayudan a responder, y aprobarlo todo con un flow anula el proceso.

questions.stem: An analytics user at Cloud Kicks needs Read, Create, and Edit access for objects and should be restricted from deleting any records. What should the administrator do to meet this requirement?

options.text: Give the user View All access and assign them to the highest role in the role hierarchy.
Assign the standard System Administrator profile to the analytics user.
Create and assign a custom profile with Delete access removed for each object.
Create and assign a permission set that includes Read, Create, and Edit access.

questions.explanationEs: Con un perfil base sin Delete, un permission set que añada Read, Create y Edit sobre los objetos da justo lo que hace falta sin permitir borrar. El perfil de System Administrator da muchos más permisos, Delete incluido, y View All solo da lectura. Un perfil personalizado también serviría, pero Salesforce recomienda perfiles mínimos y ampliar el acceso con permission sets.

questions.stem: Currently, when support reps at Ursa Major Solar close a case, they manually send an email notification to the customer. The support manager would like to automate this process, as too many reps are forgetting this step. Which two settings should the administrator use to meet this request?

options.text: Case close template in the support settings
Notify contact checkbox on close page layout
Add the Knowledge component to the closed layout
Auto-response rule step set for status of closed

questions.explanationEs: En Support Settings se elige la plantilla del email de cierre de casos, y la casilla Notify Contact del close case layout permite enviarlo al contacto en el momento de cerrar el caso. Las auto-response rules solo actúan al crear el caso, y el componente de Knowledge no envía emails.

questions.stem: When users log in to Salesforce via the user interface, which two settings does the system check for authentication?

options.text: The role IP address restrictions
The user's multi-factor authentication for User Interface Logins permission
The user's profile login hours restrictions
The user's multi-factor authentication for API Logins permission

questions.explanationEs: Al iniciar sesión por la interfaz, Salesforce comprueba, entre otras cosas, las login hours del perfil y si el usuario tiene el permiso Multi-Factor Authentication for User Interface Logins, que le obliga a verificar su identidad. Las restricciones de IP van en el perfil o en la red del org, no en el rol, y el permiso de MFA for API Logins solo afecta a los accesos por API.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar is evaluating a brand new Salesforce org for its service team and would like to know what objects will be made available out of the box with Service Cloud. Which three of the standard objects are available to an administrator considering a support use case?

options.text: Request
Ticket
Case
Contract
Account

questions.explanationEs: Case, Account y Contract son objetos estándar que vienen con Salesforce y encajan en un caso de soporte: el caso recoge la incidencia, la cuenta al cliente y el contrato sus condiciones de servicio. Request y Ticket no existen como objetos estándar: en Salesforce las incidencias son casos.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants its reports to show a Fiscal Year that starts on February 1 and has 12 months. How should the administrator address this requirement?

options.text: Set the Fiscal Year to Standard and the starting month as February.
Set the Fiscal Year to Custom and the duration to 4 quarters.
Set the Fiscal Year to Custom and the starting month as February.
Set the Fiscal Year to Standard and the duration to 12 months.

questions.reviewNote: Success4Exam marca un año fiscal Custom con inicio en febrero, pero un año fiscal Standard ya permite elegir el mes de inicio; Custom es para estructuras especiales, como trimestres 4-4-5 o 13 periodos. El Debrief y ADX201 coinciden con esta clave.
questions.explanationEs: Un año fiscal Standard sigue el calendario gregoriano y permite cambiar el mes de inicio (y si el año se nombra por el mes de inicio o por el de fin), así que basta con elegir febrero. Los Custom fiscal years son para estructuras que no encajan, como 4-4-5 o 13 periodos, y una vez activados no se pueden desactivar. La duración de 12 meses no se configura: es la del año estándar.

questions.stem: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to track ROI for contacts that are key stakeholders for opportunities. The VP of sales requested that this information be accessible on the opportunity and available for reporting. What should the administrator configure to meet these requirements?

options.text: Add the Campaign Member related list and customize Campaign Role.
Customize Campaign Member Role and add the Opportunity Contact Role related list.
Customize Opportunity Contact Role and add the Campaign Member related list.
Customize Opportunity Contact Role and add the Opportunity Contact Role related list.

questions.explanationEs: Los Opportunity Contact Roles relacionan contactos con la oportunidad e indican su papel, como decisor o influenciador. Personalizando sus roles y añadiendo su related list al page layout de Opportunity, la información se ve en el registro y se puede usar en informes. Los campaign members y sus estados sirven para campañas de marketing, no para los interesados de una oportunidad.

questions.stem: At Ursa Major Solar, a flow is in place that sends a reminder email 30 days before the warranty expiration date. A customer renews their warranty for another three years. What is the expected behavior of the email element in the flow?

options.text: The email is locked in the job queue until it meets the criteria.
The email is sent with the 30 day reminder criteria.
The email is not sent because the record no longer meets the criteria.
The email is not sent because the customer's email address was missing.

questions.explanationEs: Las acciones programadas de un flow se comprueban con los datos actuales del registro. Al renovar la garantía cambia la fecha de caducidad, el registro ya no cumple la condición del recordatorio y el email no se envía; no se queda retenido en la cola ni se envía con la fecha antigua.

questions.stem: AW Computing wants to prevent users from updating the Account Annual Revenue field to be a negative value or an amount more than $100 billion. How should an administrator accomplish this request?

options.text: Enable Account Revenue limits in Setup, with 0 as the minimum and 100 billion as the maximum.
Build a scheduled report displaying Accounts with Account Revenue that is negative or greater than 100 billion.
Make the Account Revenue field required on the page layout.
Create a validation rule that displays an error if Account Revenue is below 0 or greater than 100 billion.

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule con una condición como AnnualRevenue < 0 o AnnualRevenue > 100.000.000.000 impide guardar valores fuera de ese rango. Salesforce no tiene ningún ajuste de límites para ese campo, un informe solo encuentra los errores cuando ya existen y hacerlo obligatorio no controla el valor.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar provides a 1-year warranty on all of the panels it installs. Installation details, along with the warranty information, are captured on a custom object called Installation. The installation record is created by the installer from the mobile app. Customers sometimes receive a longer warranty as a way of increasing customer satisfaction when an installation gets delayed or has issues. How should the administrator configure Salesforce to capture the expiration date of the warranty?

options.text: Include the warranty Expiration Date field on the mobile page layout.
Add a validation rule to ensure the Expiration Date field is populated.
Create a formula field to display 1 year from the warranty purchased.
Use a formula as the default value of the warranty Expiration Date field.

questions.explanationEs: Un valor por defecto calculado con una fórmula, como la fecha de hoy más un año, rellena la caducidad al crear el registro, y el campo sigue siendo editable para ampliar la garantía cuando haga falta. Un formula field sería de solo lectura, una validation rule solo obliga a rellenarlo y ponerlo en el layout del móvil no lo calcula.

questions.stem: The marketing team at Ursa Major Solar wants to send a personalized email whenever a lead fills out the web-to-lead form on their website. They want to send different messages based on the Lead Industry field value. What should an administrator configure to meet this requirement?

options.text: Use a validation rule to trigger workflow to email the lead.
Create an assignment rule to email the lead.
Configure an auto-response rule to email the lead.
Add a public group and Process Builder to email the lead.

questions.explanationEs: Una lead auto-response rule envía un email automático al lead creado por web-to-lead, y sus rule entries pueden usar una plantilla distinta según el valor de Industry. Las validation rules no envían emails, las assignment rules solo asignan el propietario y Process Builder ya no se usa para automatizaciones nuevas.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks wants to give credit to Opportunity team members based on the level of effort contributed by each person toward each deal. What feature should the administrator use to meet this requirement?

options.text: Queues
Splits
List Views
Stages

questions.explanationEs: Opportunity Splits reparte el crédito de una oportunidad entre los miembros del opportunity team por porcentajes, según lo que haya aportado cada uno. Las colas asignan la propiedad, las list views filtran registros y las etapas reflejan el avance de la venta.

questions.stem: The sales team at Ursa Major Solar has asked the administrator to automate an outbound message. What should the administrator utilize to satisfy the request?

options.text: Process Builder
Case Auto Response Rule
Task Assignment
Record-triggered flow

questions.explanationEs: Un record-triggered flow puede enviar un outbound message como acción cuando se crea o modifica un registro, y es la herramienta recomendada ahora que workflow y Process Builder están retirados. Las auto-response rules envían emails de acuse de recibo, y una asignación de tareas no envía nada fuera de Salesforce.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty wants to offer a form on its Experience Cloud site where inspectors will submit findings from a property inspection. Which feature should an administrator place on the page to fulfill this requirement?

options.text: Autolaunched Flow
Screen Flow
Record Detail
Related List

questions.explanationEs: Un screen flow se puede colocar en una página de Experience Cloud para que los inspectores rellenen un formulario, y con esos datos crear o actualizar registros. Un autolaunched flow no tiene pantallas, y los componentes Record Detail y Related List muestran datos que ya existen.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty regularly processes customer requests for warranty work and would like to offer customers a self-serve option to generate cases. Which solutions should an administrator use to meet this request?

options.text: Email-to-Case and Case Queues
Case Queues and Case Escalation
Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case
Web-to-Case and Case Escalation

questions.explanationEs: Web-to-Case crea casos a partir de un formulario web y Email-to-Case a partir de los emails que llegan a una dirección de soporte, así que los dos permiten que el cliente abra casos por su cuenta. Las colas y las escalation rules sirven para gestionar casos que ya existen.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has decided to delete a custom field. What will happen to the data in the field when it is deleted?

options.text: The data associated with the field is removed.
The data in the field is stored for 20 days.
The data is restorable from the recycle bin.
The data is permanently deleted.

questions.reviewNote: La idea de fondo es correcta: un campo personalizado borrado se puede recuperar con sus datos durante 15 días. Pero no se restaura desde la Papelera (Recycle Bin), sino desde la lista Deleted Fields del objeto, en Object Manager.
questions.explanationEs: Al borrar un campo personalizado, el campo y sus datos se conservan 15 días y durante ese tiempo se pueden restaurar; pasado el plazo, se borran para siempre. No es un borrado inmediato ni un plazo de 20 días.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks (CK) captures whether an opportunity should be reviewed by someone in product engineering with a checkbox field called Needs Review. CK also has a picklist field on the opportunity for Product Type. When a sales rep saves an opportunity, they need to select the Product Type or check the Needs Review box. What should an administrator use to accomplish this?

options.text: Required fields
Before Save flow
Workflow rule
Validation rule

questions.explanationEs: Una validation rule puede exigir una cosa o la otra: dar error si Product Type está vacío y Needs Review no está marcado. Un campo obligatorio se exige siempre, un workflow actúa después de guardar y un before-save flow puede cambiar campos, pero no es la herramienta para impedir el guardado.

questions.stem: The VP of sales at DreamHouse Realty has requested a dashboard to visualize enterprise sales across the different teams. The key piece of data is the total of all sales for the year and the progress to the enterprise sales goal. What dashboard component will effectively show this number and the proximity to the total goal as a single value?

options.text: Donut
Gauge
Table
Stacked Bar

questions.explanationEs: Un gauge muestra un único valor, el total de ventas del año, frente a un objetivo, con rangos de colores que indican lo cerca que está de la meta. Un donut reparte un total en partes, una tabla enumera valores y una barra apilada compara categorías.

questions.stem: Sales and Customer Care at Ursa Major Solar need to see different fields on the Case related list from the Account record. Sales users want to see Case created date and status while Customer Care would like to see owner, status, and contact. What should the administrator use to achieve this?

options.text: Page Layout Editor
Related Lookup Filters
Compact Layout Editor
Search Layout Editor

questions.explanationEs: Las columnas de una related list se configuran en sus propiedades dentro del page layout. Con un page layout de Account para Sales y otro para Customer Care, asignados por perfil, cada equipo ve sus propios campos en la related list de Case. Los compact layouts controlan el panel de resumen, los search layouts los resultados de búsqueda y los lookup filters qué registros se pueden elegir en un lookup.

questions.stem: Universal Containers requires a different Lightning page to be displayed when Accounts are viewed in the Sales Console and in the Service Console. How should an administrator meet this requirement?

options.text: Define multiple record types.
Create different user profiles.
Update page layout assignments.
Assign Lightning pages as app default.

questions.explanationEs: En Lightning App Builder, una Lightning record page se puede activar como predeterminada para una app concreta (App Default), así que Account puede tener una página en la Sales Console y otra en la Service Console. Los record types, los perfiles y los page layouts no tienen en cuenta en qué app se abre el registro.

questions.stem: What are two considerations an administrator should keep in mind when working with Salesforce objects?

options.text: Custom and standard objects have standard fields.
Standard objects are included with Salesforce.
A new standard object can be created.
Only standard objects support master-detail relationships.

questions.explanationEs: Los objetos estándar vienen incluidos con Salesforce, y tanto los estándar como los personalizados tienen campos estándar, como Created By o Last Modified By. Un administrador solo puede crear objetos personalizados, no estándar, y las relaciones master-detail también admiten objetos personalizados.

questions.stem: Solar components and systems supplier, Ursa Major Solar wants to ensure that the information is up to date on their Company Information page in Salesforce. Which set of information can an administrator specify in the Company Information page?

options.text: Business hours, translation settings, corporate currency
Organization name, default time zone, default language
Primary contact, Chatter settings, set domains
Fiscal year, password policies, default time zone

questions.explanationEs: Company Information recoge los datos generales del org, como el nombre de la organización, la zona horaria y el idioma por defecto, y es el único conjunto en el que están los tres. Business hours y fiscal year tienen su propia página en Company Settings, las password policies están en la sección de seguridad, la traducción en Translation Workbench, y Chatter y los dominios tienen sus propias secciones.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to ensure that all of its locale settings are up to date and consistent in the Salesforce system. The administrator is going through the process of making updates and configuring parameters for this information. Which two sets of parameters are configured using Locale settings?

options.text: Business hours and holidays
Time and number display format
First/last name and date format
Phone number and currency format

questions.explanationEs: Según la guía oficial, el locale fija formatos que son iguales en todo su ámbito: cómo se muestran la hora y los números, el orden del nombre y los apellidos y el formato de fecha. El horario laboral y los festivos dependen de cada sede, y el formato del teléfono y de la moneda puede variar entre países que comparten locale.

questions.stem: The VP of sales has changed the naming convention for opportunities to make it more uniform across the company. The sales manager wants to update multiple opportunity names for his sales team in Europe using his “Team Europe” list view in Salesforce. Which user interface settings should be used to allow users, with all required profile permissions, to edit records in List Views?

options.text: Enable Inline Editing
Enable Enhanced Lists
Enable Enhanced Page Layout Editor
Enable Enhanced Profile List Views

questions.explanationEs: Enable Inline Editing permite editar campos directamente desde una list view, y Enable Enhanced Lists permite ver, personalizar y editar los datos de la lista con rapidez; con las dos activadas, el manager puede corregir los nombres desde su vista «Team Europe». Enable Enhanced Page Layout Editor sirve para editar page layouts, y Enable Enhanced Profile List Views para editar perfiles en bloque.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar, a medium-sized, Southwest-based supplier of solar components and systems, is growing internationally. An administrator receives details of a new hire in the Tokyo office, who requires access to the Salesforce organization. Which two requirements should the administrator consider when creating a new user in a production Salesforce org?

options.text: Usernames must be unique across all production Salesforce orgs.
Usernames must be in the form of an email address.
Usernames must be the same as the user's email address.
Usernames must include the company's email domain.

questions.explanationEs: El username debe tener formato de email y ser único en todos los orgs de producción de Salesforce, aunque no tiene por qué ser una dirección real. Por eso puede ser distinto del email del usuario y usar cualquier dominio, no solo el de la empresa.

questions.stem: A new employee is trying to login to Salesforce, but is having trouble. He reaches out to the Salesforce Admin for help. What should the administrator do first to troubleshoot login error messages?

options.text: Check the user's Login History related list on the user record.
Review entries in the Setup Audit Trail.
Log in as the user to view the error message.
Search the debug log for the error message.

questions.explanationEs: El primer paso es revisar la related list Login History del usuario, que registra cada intento de acceso y el motivo del fallo. Setup Audit Trail registra los cambios de configuración de los administradores, iniciar sesión como el usuario no reproduce su error de login y los debug logs no recogen los intentos de acceso.

questions.stem: The administrator is asked to deactivate the Salesforce user account for an employee who has recently left the company. When a user account is deactivated, what happens to the associated license?

options.text: The license becomes available for reassignment.
The license is deleted.
The license is removed from the billable licenses for the organization.
The license is automatically assigned to another user.

questions.explanationEs: Al desactivar a un usuario, su licencia queda libre para asignarla a otra persona. No se borra ni deja de facturarse, porque la empresa ya la ha pagado, y tampoco se reasigna sola: lo hace el administrador.

questions.stem: The Executive Team at Ursa Major Solar is exploring ways to increase protection of the organization’s Salesforce data from unauthorized access. It has been proposed to leverage the Trusted IP Ranges feature. What is a benefit of entering Trusted IP Ranges in the Network Access section?

options.text: Users who log in within the network are not required to verify their identity.
All attempts to log in from outside the network are denied.
Users are unable to log in through the API on networks not marked as trusted.
AppExchange packages can communicate with an external site.

questions.explanationEs: Quien inicia sesión desde un rango de Trusted IP Ranges (Network Access) no tiene que verificar su identidad con un código. Desde fuera de esos rangos se puede seguir entrando tras verificar la identidad, o con el security token si es por API, y los paquetes de AppExchange no se ven afectados.

questions.stem: Sales reps at Ursa Major Solar, who all share the same profile, report that their passwords expire too often. Where should an administrator adjust the password expiration for these users?

options.text: Individual user records
Permission sets assigned to the users
Profiles assigned to the users
Roles assigned to the users

questions.explanationEs: Como todos los afectados comparten perfil, la caducidad de la contraseña se ajusta en las password policies de ese perfil, que prevalecen sobre las del org. El registro del usuario no tiene ese ajuste, los permission sets no incluyen políticas de contraseña y los roles controlan el acceso a registros e informes.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar's Vice President of Global Sales has requested that the Sales Rep Commission report be visible to the Executive Team. How should the System Administrator provide visibility to the Sales Rep Commission report to the Executive Team only?

options.text: Set Opportunity org-wide default sharing settings to Private.
Save the report in a folder shared with the Executive Team.
Name the report "For Executive Team Use Only - Do Not Use."
Save the report in the My Personal Reports folder.

questions.explanationEs: El acceso a un informe depende de la carpeta donde se guarda: en una carpeta compartida solo con el Executive Team (por roles, grupos públicos o usuarios), solo ellos lo verán. Cambiar el OWD de Opportunity afectaría a todo el org, la carpeta personal solo la ve su propietario y poner «do not use» en el nombre no protege nada.

questions.stem: A user’s profile can be controlled by which three settings?

options.text: Record type assignment
Security at the field level
Assigned apps
Feature license assignment
Locale settings

questions.explanationEs: El perfil controla, entre otras cosas, qué record types puede usar el usuario, la seguridad a nivel de campo (field-level security) y las apps que tiene asignadas. Las feature licenses se asignan en el registro del usuario, y los ajustes de locale son preferencias del usuario, no del perfil.

questions.stem: The VP of Sales at Ursa Major Solar wants to take a look at all of the sales deals that are currently in play for the Sales team to determine how well they are tracking toward their goal for quarter end. Which standard object stores information about sales deals?

options.text: Accounts
Assets
Products
Opportunities

questions.explanationEs: Opportunity es el objeto estándar que guarda las ventas en curso, que avanzan por etapas (stages) hasta ganarse o perderse. Account guarda las empresas o personas clientes, Asset los productos que ya han comprado y Product el catálogo con sus precios.

questions.stem: A sales team member at Ursa Major Solar wants to view information related to one of their accounts to have a 360 degree view of the customer. Which two standard objects are related to Account records?

options.text: Cases
Campaigns
Opportunities
Leads

questions.explanationEs: Cases y Opportunities son objetos estándar relacionados con Account: aparecen como related lists en la cuenta y dan esa visión de 360 grados del cliente. Campaigns no se relaciona con las cuentas, y Leads tampoco: un lead se convierte en cuenta y contacto.

questions.stem: The marketing manager at Ursa Major Solar wants to run a marketing campaign for their upcoming event called the Ray-A-Thon. The manager wants to make sure to capture as much information as possible generated from the campaign in Salesforce. Which three objects have a relationship with a Campaign?

options.text: Lead
Contact
Account
Opportunity
Contact Role

questions.explanationEs: Leads y contactos se asocian a una campaña como campaign members, y las oportunidades pueden indicar la campaña de la que salieron (Primary Campaign Source) para medir su resultado. Ni las cuentas ni los contact roles tienen una relación directa con Campaign.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar needs a field that reflects Account size based on the standard field, number of employees. Which formula function should an administrator use to evaluate different results based on a specific condition with multiple outcomes?

options.text: ISPICKVAL
TEXT
IF
AND

questions.explanationEs: IF devuelve un valor si la condición es verdadera y otro si es falsa, y se pueden anidar varios IF para obtener varios resultados según el número de empleados. ISPICKVAL compara valores de picklist, TEXT convierte un valor en texto y AND solo combina condiciones.

questions.stem: The sales managers at Ursa Major Solar want Opportunities that have NOT been updated in the past 30 days to be flagged automatically. How should an administrator implement this requirement?

options.text: Create a formula field to calculate the time since last update and display an image of a red flag if it meets the defined criteria.
Add a formula to the default value of the Last Modified Date field to turn the text red if the record meets the criteria.
Add a formula to the default value of the Opportunity Name field to turn the background red if the record meets the criteria.
Create a formula field to show the last login date of the owner and display an alert message if it meets the defined criteria.

questions.explanationEs: Un formula field puede calcular los días desde la última modificación y, con la función IMAGE, mostrar una bandera roja cuando pasan de 30. Una fórmula no cambia el color del texto ni del fondo de otro campo, y la fecha del último login del propietario no dice nada de si la oportunidad se ha actualizado.

questions.stem: The Ursa Major Solar CEO does NOT want to see the list of Contacts when viewing an Account page, but still needs to access Contact records. How should the administrator configure this?

options.text: Remove read access permissions for Contacts from the CEO's profile.
Set the Contact org-wide default sharing settings to Private.
Create an Account page layout without the Contacts related list.
Remove the Account related list from the Contact page layout.

questions.explanationEs: Basta un page layout de Account sin la related list Contacts, asignado al perfil del CEO: dejará de ver la lista en la cuenta, pero podrá seguir abriendo los contactos. Quitarle el permiso de lectura le dejaría sin acceso, cambiar el OWD afectaría a todo el org y quitar la related list Account del layout de Contact cambia la página del contacto, no la de la cuenta.

questions.stem: The VP of Sales at Universal Containers wants to ensure that there is a consistent, color-coded report to easily track picklist values from the Stage field on an Opportunity. How should an administrator ensure that a picklist field’s values display in consistent colors on all reports?

options.text: Use a bucket field that defines the color for each value.
Configure report conditional highlighting for each value.
Update the picklist field and set the color for each value.
Create a formula field that defines the color for each value.

questions.explanationEs: Cada valor de un picklist puede tener un color fijo, que los gráficos de informes y dashboards usan siempre, y un formula field con la función IMAGE puede mostrar un color distinto para cada valor. Los colores de un bucket field cambian de un informe a otro, y el conditional highlighting de los informes se aplica a rangos de valores numéricos.

questions.stem: Universal Containers wants to track Invoice Payments on an Opportunity Related List. Only the Finance Team should see this Related List; however, all Users should be able to view Invoice Payment reports. How should the administrator implement this requirement?

options.text: Create a new page layout and profile for the Finance team.
Set the Invoice Payment org-wide sharing settings to Private.
Build an Invoice Payment report with a running user of Finance.
Grant Finance access only to the Invoice Payment object.

questions.explanationEs: Un page layout nuevo con la related list de Invoice Payments, asignado a un perfil del equipo de finanzas, hace que solo ellos la vean, y todos siguen pudiendo consultar los informes. Poner el OWD de Invoice Payment en Private o dar acceso solo a Finanzas impediría que el resto viera esos informes, y un informe con un running user de Finanzas no añade la related list a la página.

questions.stem: The marketing team at Ursa Major Solar wants a chart added to the home page specific to their lead generation. What should an administrator recommend to meet this requirement?

options.text: Update the marketing team's home page in the App Launcher.
Update the marketing team's home page in the Lightning App Builder.
Update the org-wide home page in the Lightning App Builder.
Update the marketing team's home page with a hyperlink to the dashboard.

questions.explanationEs: Las home pages de Lightning se editan en Lightning App Builder, y una home page propia del equipo de marketing, asignada a su perfil o a su app, puede incluir el gráfico de leads. Editar la home page de todo el org afectaría a todos los usuarios, el App Launcher no edita páginas y un enlace al dashboard no muestra el gráfico en la página.

questions.stem: The administrator updated the sales operation team’s project record page with new fields and dynamic components. However, when they refreshed the page the changes are missing. What should the administrator troubleshoot to ensure the changes are implemented?

options.text: Confirm the page is activated in the Lightning App Builder.
Create a permission set to grant access to the Project object.
Add the page to the App Launcher.
Review the component visibility filters.

questions.explanationEs: Los cambios en una Lightning record page no se ven hasta que la página está activada para la app, el record type o el perfil del equipo. El equipo ya tiene permisos sobre el objeto Project, añadir la página al App Launcher no la activa y los filtros de visibilidad afectan a componentes concretos, no a todos los cambios.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar uses a private sharing model for Cases. Each product line has several product specialists who want to have visibility to all Cases involving their product line. How should the administrator meet this requirement?

options.text: Create a predefined Case Team for each group of product specialists and assign the team using Case Assignment Rules.
Change the organization-wide default for Cases to Public Read/Write.
Give the product specialists' profile the View All permission on Cases.
Add a Product Line field to the Case page layout.

questions.explanationEs: Un case team predefinido agrupa a los especialistas de cada línea de producto con un nivel de acceso a los casos, y las case assignment rules pueden añadir ese equipo a los casos de su línea al crearlos. Así ven todos los casos de su producto y nada más. Pasar el OWD a Public Read/Write o dar View All abriría todos los casos, y un campo en el page layout no da acceso a nada.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar has three Account record types: Prospect, Customer, and Vendor. The Customer record type is only for Accounts that have a Closed Won Opportunity. How should a System Administrator prevent users from selecting the Customer record type when they create new Account records?

options.text: Remove the Customer record type as an assigned record type in the users' profiles and permission sets.
Set the Prospect record type as the default record type in the users' profiles.
Remove the Record Type field from the Account page layout.
Delete the Customer record type and create it again when an Opportunity is Closed Won.

questions.explanationEs: Al crear un registro, el usuario solo puede elegir los record types asignados en su perfil y en sus permission sets, así que basta con quitar Customer de esa asignación. Poner Prospect por defecto no impide elegir Customer, quitar el campo Record Type del layout no cambia los record types disponibles y borrar el record type afectaría a las cuentas que ya lo usan.

questions.stem: A delegated administrator at Ursa Major Solar cannot edit the Created Date field for the Account record. What reason should the administrator give for why this is occurring?

options.text: Created Date is a system audit field, and it is read-only for existing records.
The delegated administrator needs the Modify All Data permission to edit the field.
The field is hidden from the page layout assigned to the delegated administrator.
Created Date is a formula field that is recalculated every time the record is saved.

questions.explanationEs: Created Date es un campo de auditoría del sistema (system audit field) que Salesforce rellena al crear el registro y que es de solo lectura en los registros existentes, tenga el perfil que tenga el usuario. Ni siquiera Modify All Data permite editarlo; solo se puede fijar al crear registros, por ejemplo en una migración, con el permiso Set Audit Fields upon Record Creation. Tampoco es un formula field, y el page layout no influye.

questions.stem: Ursa Major Solar wants to create a field to store credit card numbers and needs to make sure the information is protected. Which two actions allow the administrator to provide enhanced security for this field?

options.text: Create an Encrypted Text field.
Update Field-Level Security settings.
Create a Text field with a validation rule that hides the value.
Make the field read-only on the page layout.

questions.explanationEs: Un campo Encrypted Text guarda el valor cifrado y lo muestra enmascarado salvo a quien tenga el permiso View Encrypted Data, y la field-level security limita qué perfiles ven el campo. Una validation rule no oculta valores, y hacer el campo de solo lectura en el page layout no impide verlo ni consultarlo desde informes o la API.

questions.stem: The customer support team wants to use a different page layout when closing a Case. Which method should the administrator use to fulfill this request?

options.text: Use a Case Close page layout.
Add a Close Case button to the existing Case page layout.
Create a new Case home page in the Lightning App Builder.
Create an escalation rule that changes the page layout when the Case is closed.

questions.explanationEs: Salesforce tiene un tipo de page layout específico para cerrar casos, el close case layout, que se asigna por perfil y puede llevar sus propios campos, como Notify Contact. Añadir un botón al layout normal no cambia el formulario de cierre, una home page no tiene que ver con el caso y las escalation rules no cambian page layouts.

questions.stem: DreamHouse Realty has a master-detail relationship with Open House as the parent object and Visitor as the child object. What should an administrator do to track the number of visitors for each open house?

options.text: Create a roll-up summary field on Open House that counts the related Visitor records.
Create a formula field on Open House that counts the related Visitor records.
Create a cross-object formula field on Visitor that references Open House.
Create a lookup field on Open House that points to Visitor.

questions.explanationEs: En un master-detail, un roll-up summary field en el maestro (Open House) puede contar los registros detalle (Visitor) y se actualiza solo. Un formula field no puede contar registros hijos, una fórmula en Visitor solo ve su propia visita y un lookup en el sentido contrario no cuenta nada.

questions.stem: Cloud Kicks has a team of product owners that need a space to share feedback and ideas with just the product team. How should the administrator leverage Salesforce to help the team collaborate?

options.text: Create a private Chatter group for the product team.
Create a public group with the product owners as members.
Create a broadcast Chatter group for the product team.
Create a Chatter stream that follows each product owner.

questions.explanationEs: Un grupo privado de Chatter solo deja ver y publicar a sus miembros, así que el equipo de producto tiene su propio espacio para compartir ideas.
